items.slavonic_diplomatic: Сообра́зенъ и҆ ѻ҆́бщникъ страда́нїй сп҃са бы́лъ є҆сѝ, на́съ ра́ди ст҃рть крⷭ҇тнꙋю подемшагѡ: и҆ ны́нѣ блаже́нне съ ни́мъ, ꙗ҆́коже ѡ҆бѣща̀ цр҃твꙋеши во вѣ́къ безконе́чныхъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion of the Saint:* Thou wast conformed unto, and a partaker of, the sufferings of the Savior, Who for our sake endured the suffering of the Cross; and now, O blessed one, as He promised, thou reignest with Him unto unending ages.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Бг҃оро́диченъ: И҆мꙋ́щи млⷭ҇рдїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ ро́ждши человѣ́колюбное сло́во, спасѝ ны нꙋ́жднагѡ и҆ лю́тагѡ ѡ҆бстоѧ́нїа: тѧ́ бо є҆ди́нꙋ вѣ́рнїи бл҃гочⷭ҇таѧ влⷣчце, предста́тельницꙋ непобѣди́мꙋ стѧжа́хомъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* Having tender mercy, as thou didst give birth unto the Word Who loves mankind save us from cruel and oppressive misfortune; for we the faithful, O all-pure Lady, have acquired thee alone as an invincible intercessor.

Thou hast come and appeared, O unapproachable Light!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пѣ́снь, з҃. і҆рмо́съ: Ѡ҆палѝ стрꙋ́ею ѕмі́євы главы̀, пе́щный высо́кїй пла́мень, ю҆́ношы носѧ́щь бл҃гочести̑выѧ, оу҆ти́шившый неꙋдободержи́мꙋю мглу̀ и҆з̾ грѣха̀, всю̀ ю҆́же ѡ҆мыва́етъ росо́ю дх҃а.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Ode 7. Heirmos:* The lofty furnace-flame burned the heads of the dragons in the stream, bearing the pious youths and quelling the unbearable gloom from sin, which He wholly washes away with the dew of the Spirit.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Тебѣ̀ живописꙋ́ющїй а҆ссѷрі́йскїй пла́мень, оу҆́гленъ поставлѧ́еши, въ ро́сѣ преведе́нъ. тѣ́мже вода̀ ны́нѣ, ꙗ҆́коже пла́мень ѡ҆дѣва́ѧй вре́днꙋю ѕло́бꙋ хрⷭ҇тѐ, прикрове́ннаго ѡ҆пла́четъ, ѿ поползнове́нныѧ стєзѝ призыва́ющи.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion of the Feast:* Depicting Thee, the Assyrian flame, transformed into dew, is laid low as a cinder; therefore the water now, clothing the harmful malice like a flame, O Christ, weeps for the hidden one, calling back from the slippery path.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Раздѣ́льшꙋсѧ і҆орда́нꙋ дре́вле, по сꙋхꙋ̀ прехо́дѧтъ лю́дїе і҆и҃лстїи. тебѐ держа́внѣйшаго содержа́ща тва́рь некосни́тельнѣ, ны́нѣ въ вода́хъ напи́сꙋющїи, къ нетлѣ́ннѣй и҆ поле́знѣй стезѝ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion of the Feast:* When the Jordan was divided of old, the people of Israel passed through on dry ground; which now depicts Thee, the Most Mighty, Who upholdest creation without delay, in the waters, leading unto an incorruptible and profitable path.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Є҆́мы пе́рвѣе всепа́гꙋбный пото́пъ, мл҃тивнѡ тѧ̀ всѣ́хъ бо тлю̀ превестѝ. ѽ превели́каѧ сотво́ршаѧ, и҆ стра̑ннаѧ! ны́нѣ же пото́пльша хрⷭ҇те грѣ́хъ за бл҃госе́рдїе, и҆ человѣ́ческое спасенїе.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion of the Feast:* We know that the all-destructive flood was formerly sent mercifully to remove the corruption of all, O Thou Who hast wrought great and marvelous things! And now, O Christ, Thou hast drowned sin because of Thy tender-heartedness and the salvation of mankind.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Показа́лъ є҆сѝ влⷣко твое́мꙋ рабꙋ̀ си́лꙋ твою̀: сегѡ̀ ра́ди преꙋсе́рднѡ къ подвигѡ́мъ прїи́де самозва́ненъ, и҆ побѣдоно́сецъ бы́въ поѧ́ше: бл҃гослове́нъ бг҃ъ ѻ҆ц҃ъ на́шихъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion of the Saint:* O Master, Thou didst show Thy power unto Thy servant; therefore he came uncalled, most eagerly, unto the contests, and having become a victor, sang: Blessed is the God of our fathers!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Бога́тство некра́домо, пребыва́ющее ѡ҆брѣ́лъ є҆сѝ досто́инство и҆ неѡ҆пада́ющее, но во вѣ́ки пребыва́ющꙋю прїѧ́лъ є҆сѝ сла́вꙋ, поѧ̀ чꙋ́дне: бл҃гослове́нъ бг҃ъ ѻ҆ц҃ъ на́шихъ.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Безнача́льномꙋ роди́телю сопребыва́ющаго при́снѡ разꙋмѣва́емаго, заче́нши дв҃о, воплоще́нна сн҃а родила̀ є҆сѝ, за є҆́же спастѝ вѣ́рою зовꙋ́щыѧ: бл҃гослове́нъ бг҃ъ ѻ҆ц҃ъ на́шихъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* Having conceived, O Virgin, the Son Who is ever understood as co-abiding with the Unoriginate Father, thou didst give birth unto Him incarnate, to save those who cry in faith: Blessed is the God of our fathers!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пѣ́снь, и҆. і҆рмо́съ: Свобо́дна оу҆́бѡ тва́рь познава́етсѧ, и҆ сы́нове свѣ́та пре́жде ѡ҆мраче́ннїи. є҆ди́нъ сте́нетъ тмы̀ предста́тель. ны́нѣ да бл҃гослови́тъ оу҆се́рднѡ вино́внаго, пре́жде ѡ҆каѧ́нное ꙗ҆зы́кѡвъ всенаслѣ́дїе.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Ode 8. Heirmos:* Creation is recognized as free, and the sons of light who were formerly darkened; the ruler of darkness alone groans. Now let the former wretched whole heritage of the nations earnestly bless the Author.[^1200]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Трїѐ бг҃овиднїи во ѻ҆гнѝ ѡ҆роша́еми, ѡ҆зарѧ́ющесѧ тремѝ всесвѣ́тлѣ стїѧ́нми, ꙗ҆́вѣ показа́ваху превы́шнее є҆стество̀ смѣше́нїемъ человѣ́ческимъ, ѻ҆гнепалѧ́щее росо́ю ми́лостивнѡ, всѧ́кꙋ па́гꙋбнꙋю льсть.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion of the Feast:* The three God-seers, bedewed in the fire and illuminated with three all-radiant beams, manifestly showed the Transcendent Nature united with human nature, mercifully burning away every destructive deceit with dew.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Да оу҆бѣли́тсѧ всѧ́кое земно́е є҆стество̀, ѿ паде́нїа ны́нѣ на нб҃о возводи́мо: и҆́мже бо всѧ̑ соблюда́ютсѧ сло́вомъ, текꙋ́щими стрꙋѧ́ми ѡ҆мы́вшысѧ, согрѣше́нїй пре́жнихъ оу҆бѣжѐ, пресвѣ́тлѡ и҆змове́но.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion of the Feast:* Let every earthly nature be made white, being led up now from the fall unto heaven; for washed by flowing streams, it hath escaped from former sins through the Word by Whom all things are preserved, being most radiantly cleansed.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Страда́льческое сопротивле́нїе страстоте́рпче, да́же до кро́ве показа́въ на землѝ полѷе́ѵкте, въ черто́гъ многосвѣ́тлый на нб҃се́хъ всели́лсѧ є҆сѝ, твои́хъ крове́й кре́щсѧ ба́нею и҆ поѧ̀ влⷣцѣ: сщ҃енницы воспо́йте, лю́дїе превозноси́те во всѧ̑ вѣ́ки.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion of the Saint:* Having shown on earth a martyr's resistance unto blood, O passion-bearer Polyeuctus, thou hast dwelt in the all-radiant bridal chamber in the heavens, baptized in the bath of thine own blood and singing unto the Master: Ye priests, hymn; ye people, supremely exalt Him unto all ages!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Оу҆мерщвле́ннꙋю паде́ньми дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ возста́ви, мꙋ́ченическымъ твои́мъ дерзнове́нїемъ ѿсе́мъ, бж҃твеннымъ повелѣ́нїемъ нїемъ, причита́ѧ сла́вне, достолѣ́пнѡ къ добродѣ́тели ѡ҆браща́ѧ вопїю́щꙋю влⷣцѣ: сщ҃енницы воспо́йте, лю́дїе превозноси́те во всѧ̑ вѣ́ки.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion of the Saint:* Raise up my soul, which is slain by falls, through thy martyr's boldness, by a divine command from on high reckoning it, O glorious one, fittingly turning her who cries unto the Master toward virtue: Ye priests, hymn; ye people, supremely exalt Him unto all ages!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Ра́дꙋйсѧ, є҆́ѧже ра́ди ѡ҆брѣто́хомъ ра́дость вѣ́чнꙋю. ра́дꙋйсѧ, є҆́ѵинꙋ печа́ль разрѣши́вшаѧ, а҆да́мово сѣтова́нїе въ свѣ́тлость ѡ҆брати́вши. ра́дꙋйсѧ бг҃а воплоще́нна ро́ждшаѧ, дв҃о бцⷣе вѣ́рныхъ предста́тельница тѧ̀ превозносѧ́щихъ во всѧ̑ вѣ́ки.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* Rejoice, thou through whom we have found eternal joy! Rejoice, thou who didst loose Eve's grief, turning Adam's lamentation into brightness! Rejoice, thou who didst give birth unto God incarnate, O Virgin Mother of God, mediatress of the faithful who supremely exalt thee unto all ages!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пѣ́снь, ѳ҃. і҆рмо́съ: Па́че оу҆ма̀ ржⷭ҇тва̀ твоегѡ̀ чꙋде́съ! невѣ́сто всечи́стаѧ, мт҃и бл҃гослове́ннаѧ, є҆́юже полꙋчи́вше всесоверше́нное сп҃се́нїе: досто́йнѡ хва́лимъ ꙗ҆́кѡ благодѣ́телѧ, да́ръ носѧ́ще пѣ́снь благодаре́нїѧ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Ode 9. Heirmos:* Beyond the mind are the marvels of thy childbearing, O all-pure Bride, blessed Mother! By whom having obtained all-perfect salvation, we worthily praise thee as Benefactress, bringing as a gift a song of thanksgiving.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Оу҆вѣ́дѣхомъ, мѡѷсе́ю кꙋпино́ю ꙗ҆вле́ннаѧ, грѧдѝ стра́нными оу҆ста́ви содѣ́ланнаѧ: ꙗ҆́кѡ бо спасе́сѧ ѻ҆́гнь носѧ́щи дв҃а, свѣтоно́сна ро́ждши благодѣ́телѧ, во і҆орда́нскихъ же стрꙋ́ѧхъ ꙗ҆вле́нна.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion of the Feast:* We have learned what was shown unto Moses by the bush; come, let us behold the things accomplished by strange ordinances; for as the Virgin was preserved carrying fire, having given birth unto the light-bearing Benefactor, so is He manifest in the streams of the Jordan.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пома́зꙋеши соверша́ѧ человѣ́ческое сꙋщество̀, царю̀ безнача́льне, дх҃а ѡ҆бще́нїемъ, стрꙋѧ́ми чи́стыми ѡ҆мы́въ и҆ тмы̀: крѣ́пость же посра́милъ возвы́шеннꙋю, ны́нѣ въ безпреста́ннемъ возда́ти житїѝ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion of the Feast:* Anointing and perfecting human nature, O King without beginning, by communion with the Spirit, having washed it with pure streams and from darkness, Thou hast put the exalted arrogance to shame, to restore it now unto an unceasing life.

items.english_text: *Troparion of the Feast:* Anointing and perfecting human nature, O King without beginning, by communion with the Spirit, having washed it with pure streams and from darkness, Thou hast put the exalted arrogance to shame, to restore it now unto an unceasing life.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Стрꙋѧ́ми мꙋ́ченическихъ и҆злїѧ́вшихсѧ твои́хъ крове́й, оу҆дави́лъ є҆сѝ вражде́бнѣйшаго ѕло́бꙋ содѣ́лавшаго, цр҃ковь же хрⷭ҇то́вꙋ напаѧ́ѧ, оу҆ѧсни́лъ є҆сѝ бг҃облаже́нне, вѣ́рою тѧ̀ при́снѡ блажа́щꙋю.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion of the Saint:* By the streams of thy martyr's blood poured forth, thou didst drown the most hostile one who wrought wickedness; and watering the Church of Christ, thou didst make her radiant, O godly-blessed one, who in faith ever blesses thee.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Бꙋ́ди мѝ мч҃нче помо́щникъ, ѿ напа́стей мѧ̀ разли́чныхъ и҆збавлѧ́ѧ и҆ ѡ҆бстоѧ́нїй, оу҆́зъ же рѣша̀ є҆́реси, и҆ лю́тыѧ свобожда́ѧ те́мницы мл҃твами твои́ми, воспѣва́ющаго тѧ̀ мы́слїю чи́стою пресла́вне.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion of the Saint:* Be a helper unto me, O martyr, delivering me from various tribulations and distresses, loosing the bonds of heresy, and setting me free from the cruel prison by thy prayers, who hymn thee with pure mind, O most glorious one.

items.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* Thou didst give birth, O all-pure one, unto Christ, the Head and the Fullness of the Law and the Prophets,[^1201] Who according to the tender mercy of His boundless abyss was well pleased to become incarnate for our sake of thee, and hath saved through faith who ever magnify thee in faith.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Свѣти́ленъ ст҃а́гѡ. Подо́бенъ: Дх҃омъ во ст҃или́щи: Многожела́нное стѧжа́въ, ѿ дꙋшѝ многожела́нныѧ, бога́тство нбⷭ҇ное, ѽ полѷе́ѵкте бл҃же́нне, и҆ сла́вꙋ и҆ свѣ́тлость: къ бз҃ѣ бы́въ, и҆ вѣне́цъ бж҃е́ственный прїѧ́лъ є҆сѝ ѿ рꙋкѝ вы́шнѧгѡ, съ мꙋ́ченическими ли́ки ꙗ҆́кѡ мꙋ́ченикъ и҆́стиненъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Exapostilarion of the Saint, Podoben: "In the Spirit in the Sanctuary" (Дꙋ́хомъ во ст҃или́щи):* Having acquired from a much-desiring soul the heavenly wealth that is greatly desired, O blessed Polyeuctus, and glory and brightness, being with God, thou didst receive a divine crown from the hand of the Most High, with the martyr ranks as a true martyr.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Въ ра́бїи ѻ҆́бразѣ прише́лъ є҆сѝ сло́ве, и҆ кр҃ще́нїѧ безлѣ́тный ꙗ҆́кѡ человѣ́къ про́сиши. оу҆жасе́сѧ землѧ̀ и҆ нб҃о, и҆ а҆́гглстїи чи́ни, и҆ во́дное є҆стество̀. предте́ча же оу҆боѧ́сѧ, стра́хомъ и҆ ра́достїю слꙋже́нїе соверша́ше.
items.english_cohort_translation: Thou didst come in the form of a servant, O Word, and as man, Thou Who art ageless, askest for baptism. Earth and heaven were dismayed, and the angelic ranks, and the watery nature. And the Forerunner was afraid, and performed his ministry with fear and joy.
items.slavonic_text: Въ ра́бїи ѻ҆́бразѣ прише́лъ є҆сѝ сло́ве, и҆ кр҃ще́нїѧ безлѣ́тный ꙗ҆́кѡ человѣ́къ про́сиши. оу҆жасе́сѧ землѧ̀ и҆ нб҃о, и҆ а҆́гглстїи чи́ни, и҆ во́дное є҆стество̀. предте́ча же оу҆боѧ́сѧ, стра́хомъ и҆ ра́достїю слꙋже́нїе соверша́ше.
items.english_text: Thou didst come in the form of a servant, O Word, and as man, Thou Who art ageless, askest for baptism. Earth and heaven were dismayed, and the angelic ranks, and the watery nature. And the Forerunner was afraid, and performed his ministry with fear and joy.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Скажѝ и҆ рцы̀ ѽ проро́че ве́лїе, кто̀ є҆́сть зовы́й въ пꙋсты́ни? что̀ вопїе́ши, почерпи́те оу҆́бѡ во́дꙋ чисти́тельнꙋ съ весе́лїемъ. сѐ і҆ѡа́ннъ креща́ѧй въ пꙋсты́ни, и҆ возопива́ѧй: хрⷭ҇то́съ грѧде́тъ, бл҃гве́нъ ꙗ҆вле́йсѧ бж҃е на́шъ сла́ва тебѣ̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: Declare and say, O great prophet, who is he that cries in the wilderness? Why criest thou: "Draw cleansing water with gladness"?[^1202] Lo, John baptizes in the wilderness and cries aloud: "Christ comes! Blessed art Thou Who hast appeared, our God, glory to Thee!"

items.slavonic_diplomatic: ѽ па́че оу҆ма̀ и҆ неизрече́ннагѡ бл҃гоꙋтро́бїа! ка́кѡ творе́цъ тва́ри прекло́нѧетъ пречⷭ҇тый и҆ бж҃твенный ве́рхъ, кр҃ще́нїемъ ѻ҆́бразъ смире́нїа вводѧ̀ въ него̀ просвѣща́емымъ? въ не́мже пое́мъ: бл҃гослове́нъ ꙗ҆вле́нїйсѧ бж҃е на́шъ сла́ва тебѣ̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: O beyond mind and ineffable loving-kindness! How doth the Creator of creation bow His most pure and divine head, by baptism introducing into it an image of humility for those who are enlightened? Wherein we sing: Blessed art Thou Who hast appeared, our God, glory to Thee!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Наслажде́нїе живо́тно ѿ пото́ка і҆орда́нова и҆сточи́сѧ на́мъ, кр҃ще́нїа бл҃гть, и҆́мже просвѣти́вшесѧ кр҃ще́нїемъ, гле́мъ: сла́ва ꙗ҆́вльшемꙋсѧ въ мі́рѣ, и҆ живо́тъ на́мъ пода́вшемꙋ. въ не́мже пое́мъ: бл҃гослове́нъ ꙗ҆вле́йсѧ бж҃е на́шъ сла́ва тебѣ̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: A living delight hath poured forth unto us from the torrent of the Jordan, the grace of baptism; whereby enlightened through baptism, we say: Glory to Him Who hath appeared in the world and granted life unto us! Wherein we sing: Blessed art Thou Who hast appeared, our God, glory to Thee!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ꙗ҆́кѡ вредѧ́щихъ земны́хъ ѿве́дшесѧ, прїиди́те мы́сленнѡ, ѡ҆чи́стимъ чꙋ́вства, и҆ хрⷭ҇та̀ ви́дѣвше пло́тїю кр҃ща́ема ѿ і҆ѡа́нна прⷭ҇те́чи, всѝ съ ни́мъ пѣсносло́вѧще вѣ́рнѡ возопїе́мъ: бл҃гослове́нъ ꙗ҆вле́нїйсѧ бж҃е на́шъ сла́ва тебѣ̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: Having turned away from harmful earthly things, come, let us spiritually cleanse our senses, and beholding Christ baptized in the flesh by John the Forerunner, let us all faithfully cry aloud, chanting with him: Blessed art Thou Who hast appeared, our God, glory to Thee!

items.verbatim_book_heading: MONTH OF JANUARY :: At the Liturgy, the Beatitudes of the Feast, Ode 4, on 6
items.verbatim_section_rubric: *At "Lord, I have cried," Stichera of Saint Gregory, Tone 2, Podoben: "O Venerable Father" (Преподо́бне ѻ҆́тче):*
items.office: At the Liturgy, the Beatitudes of the Feast, Ode 4, on 6
items.section: At "Lord, I have cried," Stichera of Saint Gregory, Tone 2, Podoben: "O Venerable Father" (Преподо́бне ѻ҆́тче)
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Прпⷣбне ѻ҆́ч҃е, сщ҃е́ннѣйше григо́рїе, тро́есть и҆спо́лнена оу҆тѣ́шителѧ дыха́нїа, и҆ ꙗ҆зы́че ꙗ҆снѣ́йшїй бл҃гоче́стїа, свѣти́льниче многосвѣ́тлый бж҃е́ственныѧ зарѝ, проповѣ́дниче и҆́стины, ѡ҆снова́нїе бг҃осло́вїа, и҆сто́чниче догма́тѡвъ высо́кихъ, наказа́нїй пото́че медото́чныхъ, цѣвни́це бг҃обѣща́ннаѧ, пѣ́сньми бг҃опи́санными наслажда́ющаѧ вѣ́рныхъ мы̑сли. хрⷭ҇та̀ молѝ, хрⷭ҇тꙋ́ помоли́сѧ всемꙋ́дре, въ стрꙋѧ́хъ і҆орда́нскихъ ѡ҆бновльшемꙋ мі́ръ, спастѝ ро́дъ на́шъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: O venerable father, most sacred Gregory,[^1205] reed filled with the breath of the Comforter, and most lucid tongue of piety, all-radiant lamp of divine brilliance, preacher of truth, foundation of theology, fountain of sublime dogmas, torrent of honey-flowing teachings, God-promised pipe delighting the thoughts of the faithful with God-inscribed songs: pray unto Christ, entreat Christ, O all-wise one, Who in the streams of the Jordan renewed the world, that He may save our race.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Прпⷣбне ѻ҆́ч҃е всече́стне григо́рїе, сѣки́ра сѣкꙋ́щаѧ є҆рети́кѡвъ стремле́нїа, ѻ҆боюдꙋ́ѡ́стрый ме́чъ оу҆тѣ́шителѧ ѻ҆рꙋ́жїе, посѣка́ющее прелюбодѣ́йннаѧ сѣ́мена. ѻ҆́гнь, хвра́стныѧ є҆́ресн попалѧ́ющїй. и҆ лопа́та, вои́стиннꙋ земледѣ́лательнаѧ, є҆́юже тѧ́жкое и҆ легко́е оу҆че́нїй бл҃горазсꙋжда́етсѧ. и҆ мѣ́рило, и҆з̾вѣ́ства всѧ̑ правѧ́щее ко стезѝ спасенїѧ. хрⷭ҇та̀ молѝ, хрⷭ҇тꙋ́ моли́сѧ всегдὰ, во стрꙋѧ́хъ і҆орда́нскихъ назда́вшемꙋ мі́ръ, спастѝ ро́дъ на́шъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: O venerable father, all-honorable Gregory, axe cutting down the onrushes of heretics, two-edged sword, weapon of the Comforter cutting off adulterous seeds, fire burning up the brushwood of heresies, and spade truly of husbandry, whereby the heavy and the light of doctrines is rightly discerned, and balance directing all certainties unto the path of salvation: pray unto Christ, entreat Christ ever, Who in the streams of the Jordan rebuilt the world, that He may save our race.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *At "Lord, I have cried," Stichera of Saint Gregory, Tone 2, Podoben: "O Venerable Father" (Преподо́бне ѻ҆́тче):*
items.office: At the Liturgy, the Beatitudes of the Feast, Ode 4, on 6
items.section: At "Lord, I have cried," Stichera of Saint Gregory, Tone 2, Podoben: "O Venerable Father" (Преподо́бне ѻ҆́тче)
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Прпⷣбне ѻ҆́ч҃е всебл҃же́нне григо́рїе, оу҆ста̀ и҆сточа́ющаѧ блаже́нныѧ гла́сы, ѿ неисхо́дныхъ спасенїѧ черплю́щаѧ, и҆ бж҃е́ственныхъ и҆сто́чникѡвъ: словеса̀ же моли́твы всѣ̑мъ сказꙋ́ѧ, пра́вило правѧ́щее къ добродѣ́тели. и҆́же видѣ́ньми бж҃е́ственными просвѣще́нъ, зарѐю ѡ҆сїѧ́емь трⷪ҇цы несозда́нныѧ, є҆́ѧже и҆ побо́рникъ непобѣди́мъ бы́лъ є҆сѝ. хрⷭ҇тꙋ́ моли́сѧ, хрⷭ҇та̀ молѝ всемꙋ́дре, въ стрꙋѧ́хъ і҆орда́нскихъ назда́вшаго мі́ръ, спастѝ ро́дъ на́шъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: O venerable father, all-blessed Gregory, lips pouring forth blessed voices, drawing from the unfailing divine fountains of salvation, and explaining the words of prayer unto all,[^1206] a rule directing unto virtue; who, enlightened by divine contemplations, art illuminated with the beam of the Uncreated Trinity, whereof thou wast an unconquerable champion: entreat Christ, pray unto Christ, O all-wise one, Who in the streams of the Jordan rebuilt the world, that He may save our race.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Other Stichera of Dometian, Tone 4, Podoben: "As One Valiant among Martyrs" (Ꙗ҆́кѡ до́блѧ):*
items.office: At the Liturgy, the Beatitudes of the Feast, Ode 4, on 6
items.section: Other Stichera of Dometian, Tone 4, Podoben: "As One Valiant among Martyrs" (Ꙗ҆́кѡ до́блѧ)
items.slavonic_diplomatic: И҆́же зе́млю и҆стреби́ти * пе́рвѣе запрети́въ всю̀, * и҆ и҆зсꙋши́ти мо́ре хва́лѧсѧ, * нарꙋга́емь вѣ́рными показа́сѧ, * ꙗ҆́кѡ пти́ца дне́сь дне́сь, и҆ посмѣѧ́тельнѣйшъ кома́ръ. є҆мꙋ́же сꙋ́дїа бѣ́дъ * ꙗ҆́коже нѣ́кое страши́лище, * и҆ попа́дасѧ хрⷭ҇то́вымъ оу҆го́дникомъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: He who previously threatened * to consume the whole earth, * and boasted that he would dry up the sea, * is shown to be mocked by the faithful, * like a bird today today, and a most laughable gnat, unto whom the judge of woes is as a scarecrow, and he falls before the pleasing servants of Christ.[^1207]

items.section: Other Stichera of Dometian, Tone 4, Podoben: "As One Valiant among Martyrs" (Ꙗ҆́кѡ до́блѧ)
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Дометїа́нъ на́съ вѣ́рнїи * созыва́етъ дне́сь, * къ трапе́зѣ бг҃оꙋго́днѣй, * къ семꙋ̀ сни́демсѧ, * благоду́шїа нра́вомъ, * и҆ спра́зднꙋимъ є҆мꙋ̀, * тогѡ̀ и҆справле́нїа, * молѧ́ще сп҃са дꙋ́шъ на́шихъ, * ми́ръ мі́рови дарова́ти.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Sticheron of the Saint:* Dometian[^1208] summons us today, ye faithful, * unto a table well-pleasing unto God; * let us come together unto him * with a cheerful disposition, * and feast together with him * for his righteous deeds, * entreating the Savior of our souls * to grant peace unto the world.

items.section: Other Stichera of Dometian, Tone 4, Podoben: "As One Valiant among Martyrs" (Ꙗ҆́кѡ до́блѧ)
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Возрасти́лъ є҆сѝ тала́нтъ хрⷭ҇то́въ, * да́нный тебѣ̀ всече́стне, * сꙋгꙋ́бою бл҃гтїю, * ꙗ҆́кѡ ра́бъ и҆́скреннїй. * тѣ́мже слы́шиши: благі́й ра́бе, бꙋ́ди тебѣ̀, * ꙗ҆́кѡ и҆́стиннѡ бл҃го́мꙋ оу҆го́дникꙋ, * и҆ ны́нѣ вни́ди въ ра́дость гдⷭ҇а твоегѡ̀, * трꙋдѡ́въ прїе́мъ воздаѧ́нїа.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Sticheron of the Saint:* Thou hast increased the talent of Christ, * given unto thee, all-honorable one, * with double grace * as a sincere servant.[^1209] * Therefore thou hearest: "Well done, good servant, so be it unto thee, * as unto a true servant of the Good One; * and now enter into the joy of thy Lord," * having received the reward of thy labors.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Премꙋ́дрости сло́во твоѐ оу҆краси́въ добродѣ́телїю непоро́чною, преꙋдо́бренъ бо ѻ҆бои́хъ бы́лъ є҆сѝ нѷсси́нскїй григо́рїе. бг҃овѣща́ннымъ твои́мъ гла́сомъ оу҆краси́ла и҆ весела̀ лю́ди разꙋ́мнѡ, трⷪ҇цы є҆динобо́жное премꙋ́дрѣ и҆злага́ѧ. тѣ́мже и҆ правосла́вными и҆ноплеме́нныѧ є҆́реси побѣди́въ, держа́вꙋ вѣ́ры въ концѣ́хъ воздви́глъ є҆сѝ, хрⷭ҇тꙋ̀ предстоя̀ съ невеще́ственными слꙋжи́тели, и҆ дꙋша́мъ на́шымъ и҆спросѝ ми́ръ и҆ ве́лїю ми́лость.
items.english_cohort_translation: Having adorned the word of wisdom with blameless virtue, thou wast exceedingly adorned in both, O Gregory of Nyssa. By thy God-proclaiming voice thou didst intelligently adorn and gladden the people, wisely expounding the unified divinity of the Trinity. Therefore having overcome foreign-born heresies by orthodox teachings, thou didst raise up the rule of faith in the ends of the earth. Standing before Christ with the bodiless ministers, ask peace and great mercy for our souls.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Other Stichera of Dometian, Tone 4, Podoben: "As One Valiant among Martyrs" (Ꙗ҆́кѡ до́блѧ):*
items.office: At the Liturgy, the Beatitudes of the Feast, Ode 4, on 6
items.section: Other Stichera of Dometian, Tone 4, Podoben: "As One Valiant among Martyrs" (Ꙗ҆́кѡ до́блѧ)
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Трепета́ше рꙋка̀ крⷭ҇ти́телева, є҆гда̀ пречи́стомꙋ твое́мꙋ ве́рхꙋ косну́сѧ, возврати́сѧ і҆орда́нъ рѣка̀ вспѧ́ть, не дерза́ющи слꙋжи́ти тебѣ̀. ꙗ҆́же бо оу҆стыдѣ́сѧ і҆исꙋ́са навѵ́на, ка́кѡ творца̀ своегѡ̀ оу҆страши́тисѧ не и҆ма́ше: но всѐ и҆спо́лнилъ є҆сѝ смотре́нїе сп҃се на́шъ, да спасе́ши мі́ръ ꙗ҆вле́нїемъ твои́мъ є҆ди́не человѣколю́бче.
items.english_cohort_translation: The hand of the Baptist trembled when it touched Thy most pure head; the river Jordan turned back, not daring to minister unto Thee. For if it was ashamed before Joshua the son of Nun,[^1210] how was it not to be afraid of its Creator? But Thou hast fulfilled the entire dispensation, O our Savior, that Thou mightest save the world by Thine appearance, O only Lover of mankind.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *At the Aposticha, Stichera, Tone 2, Podoben: "O House of Ephratha" (До́ме є҆ѵфра́ѳовъ):*
items.office: At the Liturgy, the Beatitudes of the Feast, Ode 4, on 6
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera, Tone 2, Podoben: "O House of Ephratha" (До́ме є҆ѵфра́ѳовъ)
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пѣ́нїе новолѣ́пное * да пое́тъ всѧ̀ тва́рь, * ѿ дв҃ы ро́ждшемꙋсѧ хрⷭ҇тꙋ̀, * и҆ кре́щшемꙋсѧ * во і҆орда́нѣ дне́сь.
items.english_cohort_translation: Let all creation * sing a new and fitting song * unto Christ Who was born of the Virgin * and baptized * in the Jordan today.

items.preceding_stichos: Verse:* The sea saw it and fled, * Jordan was driven back.[^1211]

items.preceding_stichos: Verse:* What ailed thee, O sea, that thou fleddest? and thou, Jordan, that thou wast driven back?[^1213]
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Розга̀ сро́дный съ высоты̀ * бж҃е́ственный дх҃ъ, * въ ви́дѣ голуби́нѣ, * зри́мь неска́заннѡ, * ны́нѣ хрⷭ҇тꙋ̀ притечѐ.
items.english_cohort_translation: The divine Spirit, akin from on high, * in the form of a dove, * seen ineffably, * hath now run unto Christ like a branch.

items.office: At the Liturgy, the Beatitudes of the Feast, Ode 4, on 6
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera, Tone 2, Podoben: "O House of Ephratha" (До́ме є҆ѵфра́ѳовъ)
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Житїѐ бж҃е́ственно и҆спра́вивъ, видѣ́нїемъ дѣѧ́нїе оу҆ѧсни́лъ є҆сѝ, бг҃облаже́нне григо́рїе го́рїе, мꙋ́дрость бо возлюби́въ жела́нїемъ бж҃итвеннымъ, и҆з̾ оу҆́стъ дх҃а бл҃года́тїю ѡ҆богати́лсѧ є҆сѝ. и҆ ꙗ҆́кѡ со́тъ ме́да сла́дость твои́хъ слове́съ накапа́ѧ, при́снѡ весели́ши ра́зꙋмы бж҃е́ственными цр҃ковь бж҃їю. тѣ́мже на нб҃сѣ́хъ стѣ́лики водворѧ́ѧсѧ, ѡ҆ на́съ непреста́ннѡ моли́сѧ, соверша́ющихъ па́мѧть твою̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: Having ordered a godly life, thou didst make action luminous through contemplation, O godly-blessed Gregory for having loved wisdom with divine desire, thou wast enriched with grace from the mouth of the Spirit. And dripping the sweetness of thy words like a honeycomb, thou ever gladdenest the Church of God with divine understandings. Therefore dwelling in the heavens with the saints, pray unceasingly for us who celebrate thy memory.

items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera, Tone 2, Podoben: "O House of Ephratha" (До́ме є҆ѵфра́ѳовъ)
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Тебѐ въ дх҃ѣ и҆ ѻ҆гнѝ ѡ҆чища́юща грѣ́хъ мі́ра, зрѧ̀ крⷭ҇ти́тель грѧдꙋ́ща къ себѣ̀, оу҆жаса́ѧсѧ и҆ трепе́ща вопїѧ́ше глаго́лѧ: не смѣ́ю держа́ти ве́рхъ тво́й пречⷭ҇тый, ты́ мѧ ѡ҆ст҃ѝ влⷣко бж҃е́ственнымъ ꙗ҆вле́нїемъ твои́мъ, є҆ди́не человѣколю́бче.
items.english_cohort_translation: Seeing Thee coming unto him, Who in the Spirit and fire cleansest the sin of the world, the Baptist cried out in trembling and fear, saying: I dare not hold Thy most pure head; do Thou sanctify me, O Master, by Thy divine appearance, O only Lover of mankind!

items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera, Tone 2, Podoben: "O House of Ephratha" (До́ме є҆ѵфра́ѳовъ)

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *At the Aposticha, Stichera, Tone 2, Podoben: "O House of Ephratha" (До́ме є҆ѵфра́ѳовъ):*
items.office: At the Liturgy, the Beatitudes of the Feast, Ode 4, on 6
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera, Tone 2, Podoben: "O House of Ephratha" (До́ме є҆ѵфра́ѳовъ)
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Во і҆орда́нѣ креща́ющꙋсѧ тебѣ̀ гдⷭ҇и, тро́ическое ꙗ҆ви́сѧ поклоне́нїе: роди́телевъ бо гла́съ свидѣ́тельствоваше тебѣ̀, возлю́бленнаго тѧ̀ сн҃а и҆менꙋ́ѧ: и҆ дх҃ъ въ ви́дѣ голꙋби́нѣ, и҆звѣ́ствоваше словесѐ оу҆твержде́нїе. ꙗ҆вле́йсѧ хрⷭ҇тѐ бж҃е, и҆ мі́ръ просвѣще́й сла́ва тебѣ̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: When Thou wast baptized in the Jordan, O Lord, the worship of the Trinity was made manifest; for the voice of the Parent bore witness unto Thee, calling Thee His beloved Son, and the Spirit in the form of a dove confirmed the certainty of the word. O Christ God Who hast appeared and enlightened the world, glory to Thee!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Стрꙋѧ́ми погре́бшемꙋ грѣ́хъ, хрⷭ҇тꙋ̀ прилѣплѧ́ѧсѧ, неѡсла́бными манове́нїи, и҆зсꙋши́лъ є҆сѝ пото́ки страсте́й, бг҃омꙋ́дре маркїа́не.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Хрⷭ҇то́съ креща́ѧсѧ, ѡ҆чища́етъ и҆стлѣ́вшее страстьми на́ше неможе́нїе: є҆мꙋ́же оу҆годи́лъ є҆сѝ маркїа́не, прилѣ́жнымъ ѻ҆́ч҃е воздержа́нїемъ.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Дв҃а пребыла̀ є҆сѝ по ржⷭ҇твѣ̀, бг҃а бо родила̀ є҆сѝ, є҆го́же вели́кїй предте́ча во і҆орда́нскихъ стрꙋ́ѧхъ крⷭ҇тѝ съ тре́петомъ мно́гимъ, пречⷭ҇таѧ бцⷣе.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Грѣ́хъ прїоц҃а̀, и҆́же и҆з̾ тебѐ рожде́йсѧ приснодв҃о, во і҆орда́нстѣй рѣцѣ̀ потоплѧ́етъ ꙗ҆́кѡ бл҃гоꙋтро́бенъ. є҆го́же предте́ча кр҃ти́ти повелѣ́нъ бы́въ, спрѧта́шесѧ.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Canon, Tone 4. Ode 1. Heirmos:*
items.office: The Office of the Venerable Marcian is chanted at Compline
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пѣ́снь, д҃. і҆рмо́съ: Дх҃омъ прови́дѧ проро́че а҆вваку́ме, словесѐ воплоще́нїе, проповѣ́далъ є҆сѝ вопїѧ̀: внегда̀ прибли́житисѧ лѣ́тѡмъ, позна́ешисѧ: внегда̀ прїитѝ вре́мени, пока́жешисѧ. сла́ва си́лѣ твое́й гдⷭ҇и.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Ode 4. Heirmos:* Foreseeing through the Spirit the incarnation of the Word, O Prophet Habakkuk, thou didst preach, crying aloud: "When the years draw near, Thou shalt be known; when the time is come, Thou shalt show Thyself. Glory to Thy power, O Lord!"[^1218]

items.verbatim_book_heading: MONTH OF JANUARY :: The Office of the Venerable Marcian is chanted at Compline
items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Canon, Tone 4. Ode 1. Heirmos:*
items.office: The Office of the Venerable Marcian is chanted at Compline
items.slavonic_diplomatic: И҆гра́йте го́ры, ликꙋ́йте хо́лми, і҆и҃съ креща́етсѧ є҆ди́нъ чи́стый, преподо́бнагѡ па́мѧть оу҆ѧсни́вый. и҆́мже демо́нѡвъ всѧ̀ ле́сть ѡ҆мрачи́сѧ, и҆ вселе́ннаѧ просвѣти́сѧ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion of the Saint:* Leap for joy, ye mountains; skip, ye hills;[^1219] Jesus, the Only Pure One, is baptized, making radiant the memory of the venerable one; whereby all the deceit of the demons is darkened, and the universe is enlightened.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Canon, Tone 4. Ode 1. Heirmos:*
items.office: The Office of the Venerable Marcian is chanted at Compline
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Оу҆мертви́въ воздержа́нїемъ плотскїѧ сла̑сти, бж҃е́ственнымъ твои́мъ проглаго́ланїемъ ѡ҆живи́лъ є҆сѝ мертвецы̀, къ погребе́нїе ѡ҆блобыза́лъ ѻ҆́ч҃е, и҆ а҆́бїе оу҆мре́ти повелѣва́ѧ, до́ндеже прїи́детъ всѣ́хъ ѻ҆́бщее воскрⷭ҇нїе.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion of the Saint:* Having slain carnal pleasures through self-mastery, by thy divine utterance thou didst raise the dead, kissing him unto burial, O father,[^1220] and commanding him straightway to die again, until the common resurrection of all shall come.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Canon, Tone 4. Ode 1. Heirmos:*
items.office: The Office of the Venerable Marcian is chanted at Compline
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Житїѐ твоѐ добро́тою бж҃е́ственныхъ добродѣ́телей оу҆кра́шено, оу҆ѧснѧ́етъ вѣ́рныѧ: моще́й же твои́хъ ра́ка ѡ҆блиста́етъ лꙋчы̑ чꙋде́съ, вѣ́рою пристꙋпа́ющымъ ѻ҆́ч҃е, и҆ вѣ́рою восхва́лѧющымъ тѧ̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion of the Saint:* Thy life, adorned with the beauty of divine virtues, enlightens the faithful; and the shrine of thy relics flashes forth rays of marvels unto those who draw near in faith, O father, and who praise thee in faith.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Бг҃оро́диченъ: И҆сто́чникъ ты̀ спасенїѧ родила̀ є҆сѝ хрⷭ҇та̀, ѡ҆свѧща́ющаго и҆сто́чники кр҃ще́нїемъ. є҆го́же і҆орда́нъ ви́дѣвъ возврати́сѧ стра́хомъ. і҆ѡа́ннъ креща́ѧй оу҆жасе́сѧ, чи́стаѧ дв҃о всепѣ́таѧ.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Дв҃а по ржⷭ҇твѣ̀ ꙗ҆ви́ласѧ є҆сѝ вои́стиннꙋ чⷭ҇таѧ, бг҃а бо родила̀ є҆сѝ. є҆го́же і҆ѡа́ннъ во вода́хъ і҆орда́нскихъ ѡ҆мыва́етъ, на ѡ҆новле́нїе мі́ра.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* A Virgin after childbearing hast thou appeared, truly pure, for thou didst give birth unto God, Whom John washes in the waters of the Jordan, unto the renewal of the world.

items.office: The Office of the Venerable Marcian is chanted at Compline
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Сѣда́ленъ, гла́съ, и҆. Подо́бенъ: Премꙋ́дрости: Писа́нїа ѿ младе́нства сщ҃еннаѧ и҆спыта́въ бг҃оно́се маркїа́не, бж҃е́ственнѣ просїѧ́лъ є҆сѝ, бл҃гоче́стїа сн҃а бо и҆ сло́ва, ѻ҆ц҃ꙋ̀ є҆диносꙋ́щна, и҆ бж҃е́ственномꙋ дх҃ꙋ проповѣ́далъ є҆сѝ сопресто́лна. тѣ́мже а҆рі́ево и҆ македо́нїево нече́стїе ѡ҆бличи́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆ вѣ́рꙋ оу҆ѧсни́лъ є҆сѝ правосла́внѡ сла́витисѧ. молѝ хрⷭ҇та̀ бг҃а, грѣхѡ́въ ѡ҆ставле́нїе пода́ти, чтꙋ́щымъ съ любо́вїю па́мѧть твою̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Sessional Hymn, Tone 8, Podoben: "Of Wisdom" (Премꙋ́дрости):* Having searched the sacred Scriptures from childhood, O God-bearer Marcian, thou didst shine forth divinely, preaching the Son and Word of piety as consubstantial with the Father, and the Divine Spirit as sharing His throne. Therefore thou didst refute the impiety of Arius and Macedonius,[^1226] and didst make clear the faith to be glorified in orthodox manner. Pray unto Christ God to grant remission of sins unto those who honor thy memory with love.

Писа́нїа ѿ младе́нства сщ҃еннаѧ и҆спыта́въ бг҃оно́се маркїа́не, бж҃е́ственнѣ просїѧ́лъ є҆сѝ, бл҃гоче́стїа сн҃а бо и҆ сло́ва, ѻ҆ц҃ꙋ̀ є҆диносꙋ́щна, и҆ бж҃е́ственномꙋ дх҃ꙋ проповѣ́далъ є҆сѝ сопресто́лна. тѣ́мже а҆рі́ево и҆ македо́нїево нече́стїе ѡ҆бличи́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆ вѣ́рꙋ оу҆ѧсни́лъ є҆сѝ правосла́внѡ сла́витисѧ. молѝ хрⷭ҇та̀ бг҃а, грѣхѡ́въ ѡ҆ставле́нїе пода́ти, чтꙋ́щымъ съ любо́вїю па́мѧть твою̀.

cohort_provenance.verbatim_source:
*Sessional Hymn, Tone 8, Podoben: "Of Wisdom" (Премꙋ́дрости):*
Having searched the sacred Scriptures from childhood, O God-bearer Marcian, thou didst shine forth divinely, preaching the Son and Word of piety as consubstantial with the Father, and the Divine Spirit as sharing His throne. Therefore thou didst refute the impiety of Arius and Macedonius,[^1226] and didst make clear the faith to be glorified in orthodox manner. Pray unto Christ God to grant remission of sins unto those who honor thy memory with love.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Жи́зни наста̀ и҆сто́чникъ, вода́ми ѡ҆мыва́ющїй прегрѣше́нїа на́ша, бж҃їе є҆диноро́дное безнача́льное сло́во: є҆мꙋ́же бл҃гоꙋгодѝ маркїа́нъ сла́вный, преложи́сѧ къ немꙋ̀.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Canon, Tone 4. Ode 1. Heirmos:*
items.office: The Office of the Venerable Marcian is chanted at Compline
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Бг҃омо́щными бдѣ́нїи вои́стиннꙋ, оу҆спи́лъ є҆сѝ стра̑сти неꙋдободержи̑мыѧ дꙋшѝ. и҆ оу҆сну́въ во глубоча́йшей ста́рости блаже́нне, къ свѣ́тꙋ ѿше́лъ є҆сѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ днѐ сы́нъ, и҆ хрⷭ҇товъ слꙋжи́тель.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion of the Saint:* By God-strengthened vigils, truly, thou didst lull to sleep the stubborn passions of the soul; and having fallen asleep in extreme old age, O blessed one, thou didst depart unto the Light as a son of day and a minister of Christ.[^1227]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Вмѣща́еши невмѣсти́маго дв҃о па́че оу҆ма̀, є҆го́же и҆мѣ́ѧ предте́ча кр҃ти́ти, оу҆жаса́ѧсѧ и҆ трепе́ща вопїѧ́ше: ѻ҆́гнь сы́й хрⷭ҇тѐ не ѡ҆палѝ менѐ, любо́вїю пою́ща тѧ̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* Thou containest beyond understanding Him Who cannot be contained, O Virgin; Whom when the Forerunner was about to baptize, he cried in dread and trembling: "Being Fire, O Christ, burn me not, who hymn Thee with love!"

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пѣ́снь, ѳ҃. і҆рмо́съ: Живопрїе́мный и҆сто́чникъ принотекꙋ́щїй, свѣтоно́сный свѣти́льникъ благода́ти, хра́мъ ѡ҆дꙋшевленный, сѣ́нь пречⷭ҇тꙋю, нб҃сѐ и҆ землѝ простра́ннѣйшꙋю, бцⷣꙋ вѣ́рнїи велича́емъ.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Торжествꙋ́йте дне́сь человѣ́цы, рѣ́ки и҆ гѡ́ры и҆гра́йте, і҆и҃съ кр҃ща́етсѧ, сп҃съ ꙗ҆ви́сѧ, и҆ спросла́влѧетъ свои́мъ ꙗ҆вле́нїемъ маркїа́на ст҃о́е преставле́нїе.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion of the Saint:* Celebrate today, ye men; leap for joy, ye rivers and mountains; Jesus is baptized, the Savior hath appeared, and by His appearance glorifies the holy translation of Marcian.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Canon, Tone 4. Ode 1. Heirmos:*
items.office: The Office of the Venerable Marcian is chanted at Compline
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Жела́нїй кра́йнѣйшее дости́глъ є҆сѝ, ѿрѣши́всѧ оу҆́зъ тѣле́сныхъ бг҃оно́се преподо́бне, зрѧ̀ свѣ́тлости ст҃ителе́й, проро́кѡвъ, и҆ а҆по́столѡвъ, съ ни́миже на́съ чтꙋ́щихъ тѧ̀ помина́й.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion of the Saint:* Thou hast reached the utmost of desires, having been loosed from bodily bonds, O God-bearing venerable one, beholding the brightness of the hierarchs, prophets, and apostles; together with them remember us who honor thee.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Но́сиши бг҃а на рꙋкꙋ̀, пита́ющаго бг҃одѣ́лною си́лою всѧ́ческаѧ. є҆го́же ви́дѣвъ предте́ча кр҃ще́нїѧ просѧ́ща, недоꙋмѣва́етъ оу҆́жасомъ бг҃ороди́тельнице, и҆ и҆сполнѧ́етъ со стра́хомъ повелѣ́нное.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* Thou bearest God in thine arms, Who with God-working power nourishes all things; Whom seeing asking for baptism, the Forerunner is lost in amazement with dread, O Parent of God, and fulfills with fear what was commanded.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ѻ҆́ч҃е сщ҃е́ннѣйше, твоегѡ̀ житїѧ̀ свѣ́тлостьми вселе́ннаѧ просвѣти́сѧ, и҆ ѡ҆мрачи́сѧ де́мѡнскаѧ ле́сть, недꙋ́зи ѿгонѧ́ютсѧ то́чїю прикоснове́нїемъ нїемъ ра́ки твоеѧ̀. бж҃твеннаѧ бо бл҃года́ть твоѧ̑ мо́щы ѡ҆сїѧ́вши, страсте́й рѣши́тъ ѡ҆мраче́нїе.
items.english_cohort_translation: O most sacred father, by the splendors of thy life the universe hath been enlightened, and demonic deceit hath been darkened; diseases are driven away merely by the touch of thy shrine; for divine grace, illuminating thy relics, looses the darkness of passions.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ѻ҆́ч҃е досточꙋ́дне, хра́мъ себѐ сотвори́лъ є҆сѝ присносꙋ́щнагѡ бж҃тва̀: хра́мы же воздви́глъ є҆сѝ сщ҃енныѧ бж҃е́ственнѣй трⷪ҇цѣ на похвале́нїе. ме́ртвыѧ же возста́вилъ є҆сѝ глаго́ломъ, и҆ ми́лостивенъ стѧжа́лъ є҆сѝ нра́въ, разда́лъ є҆сѝ бога́тство просѧ́щымъ, со оу҆се́рдїемъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Sticheron of the Saint:* O father worthy of marvel, thou madest thyself a temple of the ever-existing Godhead; and thou didst erect sacred temples unto the praise of the Divine Trinity. By a word thou didst raise the dead, and didst acquire a merciful disposition, distributing wealth unto those who ask with eagerness.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Наго́тꙋ проси́вшагѡ ꙗ҆́вѣ ѻ҆́ч҃е покры́лъ є҆сѝ, на́гъ са́мъ входѧ̀ во хра́мъ ст҃ы́й, бж҃е́ственною же ѡ҆де́ждою тѧ̀ хрⷭ҇то́съ ѡ҆блечѐ, бж҃е́ственнаѧ соверша́юща та́инства: є҆́ѧже оу҆диви́шасѧ добро́тѣ ви́дѣвшїи, и҆ бж҃їѧ тѧ̀ позна́вше оу҆го́дника.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Canon, Tone 4. Ode 1. Heirmos:*
items.office: The Office of the Venerable Marcian is chanted at Compline
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Бо́ѧсѧ твоегѡ̀ прише́ствїѧ хрⷭ҇тѐ, ѻ҆ба́че повелѣ́нїю твое́мꙋ не проти́влюсѧ ра́бъ тво́й, сѐ рꙋ́кꙋ мою̀ простира́ю со стра́хомъ. ви́ждꙋ бо ст҃а́го со высоты̀ схода́ща дх҃а, влⷣко, твоегѡ̀ є҆диноче́стнаго, и҆ ѻ҆ц҃ꙋ̀ безнача́льномꙋ сопресто́лна, свидѣ́тельствꙋюща тѧ̀ пло́тїю креща́ема.
items.english_cohort_translation: Fearing Thy coming, O Christ, yet Thy servant opposes not Thy command: lo, with fear I stretch forth my hand. For I behold the Holy Spirit descending from on high, O Master, equal in honor with Thee and sharing the throne of the Unoriginate Father, bearing witness unto Thee baptized in the flesh.

items.section: At Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 3, Podoben: "Today the Virgin" (Дѣ́ва дне́сь)
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Вла́ка дне́сь на і҆орда́нъ прїи́де, крести́тисѧ въ вода́хъ, ѿ бж҃е́ственнагѡ прⷭ҇те́чи. свы́ше же ѻ҆ц҃ъ свидѣ́тельствоваше, се́й є҆́сть сн҃ъ мо́й въ не́мже бл҃гоизво́лихъ. и҆ дх҃ъ ꙗ҆ви́сѧ стра́ннымъ ви́домъ голꙋби́нымъ над̾ ни́мъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Today the Master comes unto the Jordan to be baptized in the waters by the divine Forerunner. And from on high the Father bore witness: "This is My beloved Son, in Whom I am well pleased;"[^1230] and the Spirit appeared over Him in the strange form of a dove.

items.office: At Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 3, Podoben: "Today the Virgin" (Дѣ́ва дне́сь)
items.section: After the 2nd Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 4, Podoben: "Joseph Marveled" (Оу҆диви́сѧ І҆ѡ́сифъ)
items.slavonic_diplomatic: И҆збавлє́нїа вре́мѧ, хрⷭ҇то́съ ꙗ҆ви́сѧ на́мъ во і҆орда́нѣ рѣцѣ̀, прїиди́те почерпе́мъ вѣ́рнїи во́дꙋ ѡ҆ставле́нїа грѣхѡ́въ на́шихъ. хрⷭ҇то́съ бо пло́тїю прїи́де, ѡ҆вчатѐ и҆щѧ̀ ѕвѣрьмѝ похи́щеннаго, и҆ ѡ҆брѣ́тъ введѐ ꙗ҆́кѡ бл҃гоꙋтро́бенъ въ ра́й па́ки. хрⷭ҇то́съ ꙗ҆ви́сѧ на і҆орда́нѣ, и҆ мі́ръ просвѣтѝ.
items.english_cohort_translation: The time of redemption: Christ hath appeared unto us in the river Jordan! Come, ye faithful, let us draw water for the remission of our sins; for Christ is come in the flesh, seeking the sheep carried off by wild beasts,[^1231] and having found it, as He is tender-hearted, He hath brought it into Paradise again. Christ hath appeared at the Jordan and enlightened the world!

items.office: At Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 3, Podoben: "Today the Virgin" (Дѣ́ва дне́сь)
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Глꙋбины̀ ѿкры́лъ є҆́сть дно̀, и҆ сꙋ́шею своѧ̑ влече́тъ, въ не́й покры́въ проти́вныѧ, крѣ́пкїй во бра́нехъ гдⷭ҇ь, ꙗ҆́кѡ просла́висѧ.
items.english_cohort_translation: He uncovered the bottom of the deep, and leads His own on dry land, having covered the adversaries therein, the Lord mighty in battles: for He is glorified![^1232]

items.office: At Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 3, Podoben: "Today the Virgin" (Дѣ́ва дне́сь)
items.slavonic_diplomatic: А҆да́ма и҆стлѣ́вшаго ѡ҆бновлѧ́етъ стрꙋѧ́ми і҆орда́нскими: и҆ ѕмї́евъ главы̀ гнѣзди́вшихсѧ сокрꙋша́етъ, цр҃ь вѣ́кѡвъ гдⷭ҇ь, ꙗ҆́кѡ просла́висѧ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion of the Feast:* He renews Adam who had rotted away with the streams of the Jordan, and crushes the heads of the dragons that nested therein, the Lord the King of the ages: for He is glorified!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ѻ҆гне́мъ бж҃тва̀ невеще́ственнымъ, въ пло́ть веще́ственнꙋ ѡ҆дѣ́ѧвсѧ: і҆орда́нскою ѡ҆блага́етсѧ водо́ю, воплоще́нсѧ ѿ дв҃ы гдⷭ҇ь, ꙗ҆́кѡ просла́висѧ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion of the Feast:* Clothed in material flesh through the immaterial fire of the Godhead, the Lord, incarnate of the Virgin, is compassed by Jordan's water: for He is glorified!

items.office: At Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 3, Podoben: "Today the Virgin" (Дѣ́ва дне́сь)
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Скве́рнꙋ ѡ҆мыва́ѧй чл҃кѡвъ, си̑мъ ѡ҆чи́щисѧ во і҆орда́нѣ: и҆̀мже восхотѣ́въ оу҆подо́бисѧ, є҆́же бѣ̀ пребы́въ, сꙋ́щыѧ во тмѣ̀ просвѣща́ѧй гдⷭ҇ь, ꙗ҆́кѡ просла́висѧ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion of the Feast:* Washing away the filth of men, He is cleansed with them in the Jordan; having willed to be made like unto them while remaining that which He was, the Lord Who enlightens those in darkness: for He is glorified!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Бе́здна сы́й премꙋ́дрости, и҆ ра́зꙋма сокро́вище, и҆ самоблагости и҆сто́чникъ сы́й, да́еши мѝ хрⷭ҇тѐ сла́вныѧ твоеѧ̀ цр҃кве, пѣ́сньми свѣти́лника пѣ́ти григо́рїа.

items.office: At Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 3, Podoben: "Today the Virgin" (Дѣ́ва дне́сь)
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Прїими оу҆чи́телей григо́рїе свѣ́тлое оу҆добре́нїе ѻ҆́ч҃е, оу҆бо́гое пѣ́нїе твое́й приноси́мое ѿ любвѐ па́мѧти, въ не́йже хрⷭ҇та̀ на́мъ оу҆ми́лостиви.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Receive, O father Gregory, bright adornment of teachers, the humble singing offered out of love unto thy memory, wherein do thou make Christ merciful unto us.

items.office: At Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 3, Podoben: "Today the Virgin" (Дѣ́ва дне́сь)
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ѡ҆брѣ́те ѡ҆чище́нꙋ сщ҃е́ннꙋю твою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ, ѿ страсте́й ти́мѣнїѧ, сїѧ́нїе непристꙋ́пное. тѣ́мже ꙗ҆́кѡ всели́всѧ въ тѧ̀ ѻ҆́ч҃е, свѣ́тъ тѧ̀ показа̀, наꙋча́юща земны̑ѧ концы̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* The unapproachable Radiance found thy sacred soul cleansed from the mire of the passions; therefore, having made His abode in thee, O father, He showed thee forth as a light, instructing the ends of the earth.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Сло́вомъ сщ҃енота́инниче бога́тымъ же и҆ мꙋ́дрымъ, чтⷭ҇нꙋю цр҃ковь бг҃ослови́ти наꙋчи́лъ є҆сѝ є҆ди́ницꙋ трїѵпоста́снꙋю, и҆ трⷪ҇цꙋ сопресто́лнꙋ и҆ є҆диноче́стнꙋ, ѽ григо́рїе.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* By thy rich and wise word, O sacred initiate of mysteries, thou didst teach the honorable Church to theologize the Tri-hypostatic Monad, and the Trinity enthroned together and equal in honor, O Gregory.[^1235]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Богородиченъ: Вѣ́ра да вмѣнѧ́етсѧ є҆ди́на, а҆ не показа́нїе, сщ҃енныхъ па́че оу҆ма̀ чꙋде́съ, бг҃ороди́тельнице дв҃о твои́хъ. и҆́бо непостижи́маго бг҃а сло́ва родила̀ є҆сѝ, ѡ҆бле́кшасѧ въ человѣ́чество.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* Let faith alone be accounted, and not demonstration, for thy sacred wonders surpassing understanding, O Virgin Mother of God; for thou didst give birth unto the incomprehensible God the Word, Who clothed Himself in humanity.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Воста̑нїѧ пло́ти, и҆ страсте́й наше́ствїѧ бг҃опрїѧ́тне, и҆ востаю́щꙋю въ дꙋшѝ мое́й оу҆кротѝ бра́нь, въ ми́рнѣ ѻ҆́ч҃е оу҆строе́нїи соблюдѝ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Subdue the risings of the flesh and the assaults of passions, O God-receiver, and quell the warfare rising up in my soul, and keep me in a peaceful state, O father.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Жела́нїемъ и҆ любвѐ неꙋкло́нною, вы́шней премꙋ́дрости прикоснꙋ́всѧ, пло́ть покори́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆ сꙋ́щаѧ земна̑ѧ ѿтрѧ́слъ є҆сѝ преподо́бне, и҆ бг҃ꙋ и҆́стиннѡ въ прича́стїи бы́лъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Having attained unto the wisdom on high through desire and steadfast love, thou didst subdue the flesh, and didst shake off earthly things, O venerable one, and wast truly in communion with God.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Богородиченъ: Рода́ми ѡ҆моче́нъ пло́ти, є҆́же прїѧ́тъ гдⷭ҇ь смѣше́нїе, ѿ твои́хъ содѣ́ла дѣ́вственныхъ крове́й чл҃чество, ко ѡ҆полче́нїемъ проти́вныхъ непобо́рно.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* Steeped in the births of the flesh, the union which the Lord received He fashioned into humanity from thy virginal blood, invincible against the battle lines of adversaries.

items.office: At Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 3, Podoben: "Today the Virgin" (Дѣ́ва дне́сь)
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Крѣ́пость даѧ́й цр҃е́мъ на́шымъ гдⷭ҇ь, и҆ ро́гъ пома́занныхъ свои́хъ возносѧ́й, ѿ дв҃ы ражда́етсѧ, грѧде́тъ же ко кр҃ще́нїю. томꙋ̀ вѣ́рнїи возопїи́мъ: нѣ́сть ст҃ъ, ꙗ҆́кѡ бг҃ъ на́шъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: The Lord Who gives strength unto our kings, and exalts the horn of His anointed ones, is born of the Virgin, and comes unto baptism; unto Him let us, the faithful, cry aloud: There is none holy as our God![^1239]

items.office: At Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 3, Podoben: "Today the Virgin" (Дѣ́ва дне́сь)
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Непло́днаѧ дре́вле и҆ безча́днаѧ лю́тѣ, дне́сь весели́сѧ хрⷭ҇то́ва цр҃ковь: водо́ю бо и҆ дх҃омъ сы́нове тебѣ̀ роди́шасѧ, вѣ́рою взыва́юще: нѣ́сть ст҃ъ, ꙗ҆́коже бг҃ъ на́шъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion of the Feast:* Rejoice today, O Church of Christ, she that formerly was barren and grievously childless; for by water and the Spirit sons are born unto thee, crying out in faith: There is none holy as our God![^1240]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ве́лїимъ гла́сомъ въ пꙋсты́ни вопїе́тъ предте́ча: хрⷭ҇тꙋ̀ оу҆гото́вайте пꙋ́ти, и҆ стєзѝ бг҃ꙋ на́шемꙋ пра̑вы содѣ́лайте, вѣ́рою взыва́юще: нѣ́сть ст҃ъ, ꙗ҆́коже бг҃ъ на́шъ.

items.office: At Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 3, Podoben: "Today the Virgin" (Дѣ́ва дне́сь)
items.slavonic_diplomatic: И҆́нъ. і҆рмо́съ: Водрꙋзи́вый на ничесо́мже зе́млю повелѣ́нїемъ твои́мъ, и҆ повѣ́сивый неꙋдержи́мѡ тѧготѣ́ющꙋю, на недви́жимѣмъ хрⷭ҇тѐ ка́мени, за́повѣдей твои́хъ, цр҃ковь твою̀ оу҆твердѝ є҆ди́не бл҃же, и҆ чл҃вѣколю́бче.
items.english_cohort_translation: Thou Who didst establish the earth upon nothing by Thy command, and didst suspend what gravitates uncontrollably, establish Thy Church upon the immovable rock of Thy commandments, O Christ, Who alone art good and the Lover of mankind.[^1242]

items.office: At Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 3, Podoben: "Today the Virgin" (Дѣ́ва дне́сь)
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пло́ти оу҆́бѡ блꙋ́дъ оу҆́мꙋ бз҃ыгра́нїа, всецѣ́ло же оу҆́мъ покори́лъ є҆сѝ. тѣ́мже непреткнове́ннѡ пꙋ́ть за́повѣдей проше́дъ, ты̀ трⷪ҇цы ѡ҆би́телище бы́лъ є҆сѝ лѣ́потно, григо́рїе.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Thou didst completely subject unto the mind the flesh's errant wantonness; therefore, having traversed the path of the commandments without stumbling, thou didst fittingly become an abode of the Trinity, O Gregory.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Подо́бнѡ ꙗ҆́ростное оу҆́бѡ на ѕмі́а дꙋшѝ воѡрꙋжи́лъ є҆сѝ всеблаже́нне, жела́нїе же бг҃ꙋ всекꙋ́пнѡ просте́ръ, къ недомы́сленнѣй, и҆ неизмѣ́ннѣй добро́тѣ впери́лъ є҆сѝ преподо́бне.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Fittingly thou didst arm the irascible power of the soul against the serpent, O all-blessed one; and having wholly extended thy longing unto God, thou didst take wing unto the unsearchable and immutable beauty, O venerable one.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Дѣѧ́нїю видѣ́нїе ѻ҆́ч҃е приложи́лъ є҆сѝ, тѣ́мже ѻ҆́бласть цр҃кве тебѣ̀ приносѧ́ врꙋча́етъ хрⷭ҇то́съ, ю҆́же оу҆́бѡ непоро́чнѡ ꙗ҆́кѡ неѡта́инникъ оу҆пра́вилъ є҆сѝ и҆зрѧ́днѣйшїй, всеблаже́нне григо́рїе.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Thou didst join contemplation unto action, O father; therefore Christ, bringing it to thee, entrusted the governance of the Church, which thou didst steer blamelessly as an exquisite initiate of mysteries, O all-blessed Gregory.

items.office: At Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 3, Podoben: "Today the Virgin" (Дѣ́ва дне́сь)
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Проходѧ̀ добродѣ́телей предѣ́лъ григо́рїе, и҆ восхожде́нїа въ срⷣцы твоемъ ты̀ полага́ѧ, ѿ землѝ взѧ́лсѧ є҆сѝ, непреста́ннымъ тече́нїемъ, къ нбⷭ҇номꙋ жи́тельствꙋ, пре́жде ѿ пло́ти и҆зше́ствїа твоегѡ̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Traversing the boundary of the virtues, O Gregory, and setting ascents in thy heart, thou wast taken up from the earth by unceasing course unto heavenly citizenship, even before thy departure from the flesh.

items.office: At Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 3, Podoben: "Today the Virgin" (Дѣ́ва дне́сь)
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Богородиченъ: Ты̀ мт҃и бж҃їа негоꙋта́ннѡ родила̀ є҆сѝ, и҆з нетлѣ́ннагѡ ѻ҆ц҃а̀ возсїѧ́вшаго, безъ болѣ́зней ма́тернихъ. тѣ́мже тѧ̀ бцⷣꙋ, воплоще́ннаго ро́ждшꙋ сло́ва, правосла́внѡ проповѣ́дꙋемъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* Thou, O Mother of God, didst ineffably give birth unto Him Who shone forth from the incorrupt Father, without maternal pangs; therefore we orthodoxly proclaim thee to be the Birthgiver of God, who didst bear the incarnate Word.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: И҆́нъ. і҆рмо́съ: Є҆ди́не вѣ́дый человѣ́ческагѡ сꙋщества̀ не́мощь, и҆ млⷭ҇тивнѡ лостивнѡ въ нѐ воѡбрази́сѧ, препоѧ́ши мѧ̀ съ высоты̀ си́лою, є҆́же вопи́ти тебѣ̀ ст҃ы́й: ѡ҆дꙋшевленный хра́ме, неизрече́нныѧ сла́вы твоеѧ̀ чл҃колю́бче.
items.english_cohort_translation: Thou Who alone knowest the weakness of human nature, and mercifully and mercifully formed in it, gird me with power from on high to cry aloud unto Thee, O Holy One: The animate temple of Thine ineffable glory, O Lover of mankind.[^1243]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Въ крѣ́пости свое́й вра́гъ преветхі́й, твоеѧ̀ дꙋ́ши не моги́й крѣ́пости поколеба́ти, оу҆хищрѧ́етъ во вре́мѧ твоегѡ̀ разрѣше́нїѧ, та́йнами пти́цъ хꙋды́хъ низложи́ти.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* The ancient enemy, unable in his might to shake the strength of thy soul, contrived at the time of thy departure to cast thee down through the phantasms of vile birds.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Велехвале́нїемъ свои́мъ, пра́веднѡ и҆зничтожа́етсѧ прива́звані́емъ ѕмі́й ѡ҆каѧ́нный. и҆ въ ви́дъ пе́сїихъ мꙋ́хъ преврати́сѧ, немо́щїю множа́йшею. и҆ под нога́ми лежи́тъ вѣ́рныхъ кра́сными попира́емь.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* In his vaunting, the wretched serpent is justly brought to nothing by invocation; and he was turned into the likeness of dog-flies in utmost weakness, and lies beneath the fair feet of the faithful, being trampled down.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Богородиченъ: И҆з̾ тебѐ рожде́йсѧ без̾ сѣ́мене сн҃ъ превѣ́чный, дв҃о мт҃и, мі́ръ ѡ҆бновѝ, сокрове́ннаго ѕмі́а, вода́ми въ креще́нїи свое́мъ оу҆мертви́въ гдⷭ҇ь, и҆ тлѣ́нїа человѣ́ки и҆зба́вивъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* The pre-eternal Son born of thee without seed, O Virgin Mother, renewed the world; the Lord, having put to death the hidden serpent with waters at His baptism, delivered men from corruption.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: І҆́косъ: Галїле́и ꙗ҆зы́честѣй, завꙋлѡ́нстѣй странѣ̀, и҆ нефѳалї́мстѣй землѝ, ꙗ҆́коже речѐ проро́къ, свѣ́тъ вели́къ возсїѧ̀ хрⷭ҇то́съ. ѡ҆мраче́ннымъ свѣ́тлаѧ ꙗ҆ви́сѧ зарѧ̀, и҆з̾ виѳлее́ма ѡ҆блиста́ющаѧ, па́че же и҆з̾ марї́и гдⷭ҇ь, все́й вселе́нней возсїѧва́етъ лꙋчы̀ со́лнце пра́вды. тѣ́мже и҆́же ѿ а҆да́ма назі́и, прїиди́те всѝ ѡ҆блече́мсѧ въ него̀, да согрѣ́емсѧ: покрыва́етъ бо нагі́ѧ, и҆ просвѣща́етъ те́мныѧ. прише́лъ є҆сѝ и҆ ꙗ҆ви́лсѧ є҆сѝ свѣ́тъ непристꙋ́пный.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Ikos:* Unto Galilee of the Gentiles, unto the country of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali, as the Prophet said, a great light hath shone forth, even Christ.[^1245] Unto those darkened, a radiant dawn hath appeared, flashing forth from Bethlehem, or rather the Lord from Mary; the Sun of Righteousness shines forth rays upon the whole universe.[^1246] Therefore, ye who are naked from Adam, come, let us all clothe ourselves in Him, that we may be warmed; for He covers the naked, and enlightens the darkened. Thou hast come and hast appeared, the Light unapproachable!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Бж҃твенное ѡ҆сїѧ́нїе наслѣ́довалъ є҆сѝ, житїѐ невеще́ственно пожи́въ. тезоимени́тнымъ сщ҃е́нствомъ процвѣ́лъ є҆сѝ, преесте́ственнѡ бо оу҆ѧ́снивъ оу҆че́нїи, правосла́вїемъ мі́ръ оу҆тверди́лъ є҆сѝ, ѻ҆́ч҃е преподо́бне, хрⷭ҇та̀ бг҃а молѝ, дарова́ти на́мъ ве́лїю мл҃ть.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Sessional Hymn of Saint Gregory, Tone 3, Podoben: "Of the Divine Faith" (Бж҃е́ственныѧ вѣ́ры):* Thou didst inherit the divine illumination, having lived an immaterial life; thou didst blossom forth with priesthood answering to thy name;[^1247] for having clarified with teachings surpassing nature, thou didst establish the world in orthodoxy, O venerable father: entreat Christ God to grant us great mercy.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Сщ҃е́нства оу҆краша́емь ѻ҆́ч҃е пома́занїемъ бг҃оданнымъ, оу҆ѧсни́лъ є҆сѝ сїѐ бж҃твенными добро́тами добро́тами добродѣ́телей, и҆ бж҃е́ственныхъ ко хрⷭ҇тꙋ̀ повинове́нїемъ. и҆ сконча́въ твоѐ тече́нїе, на нб҃сѣ́хъ вопїе́ши со а҆́гг҃лы: сла́ва бл҃гоꙋтро́бїю твое́мꙋ сп҃се: сла́ва црⷭ҇твїю твое́мꙋ: сла́ва смотре́нїю твое́мꙋ є҆ди́не чл҃колю́бче.
items.english_cohort_translation: Adorned, O father, with the God-given anointing of the priesthood, thou didst make it radiant with divine virtues radiant with divine virtues of excellence and divine obedience unto Christ; and having finished thy course, thou criest aloud in the heavens with the angels: Glory to Thy compassion, O Savior; glory to Thy kingdom; glory to Thy dispensation, O Thou Who alone art the Lover of mankind!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: И҆́же ро́ждшемꙋсѧ ѿ дв҃ы мр҃і́и, и҆ во і҆орда́нѣ кре́щшемсѧ ѿ і҆ѡа́нна: дх҃ъ сни́де на него̀, зри́мый въ ви́дѣ голꙋби́нѣ. сегѡ̀ ра́ди прⷪ҇ро́къ со а҆́гг҃лы глаго́лаше зовы́й: сла́ва прише́ствїю твое́мꙋ хрⷭ҇тѐ: сла́ва црⷭ҇твїю твое́мꙋ: сла́ва смотре́нїю твое́мꙋ: є҆ди́не чл҃колю́бче.
items.english_cohort_translation: Unto Him Who was born of the Virgin Mary, and baptized in the Jordan by John: the Spirit descended upon Him, seen in the form of a dove. Therefore the Prophet with the angels cried aloud, saying: Glory to Thy coming, O Christ; glory to Thy kingdom; glory to Thy dispensation, O Thou Who alone art the Lover of mankind!
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же ро́ждшемꙋсѧ ѿ дв҃ы мр҃і́и, и҆ во і҆орда́нѣ кре́щшемсѧ ѿ і҆ѡа́нна: дх҃ъ сни́де на него̀, зри́мый въ ви́дѣ голꙋби́нѣ. сегѡ̀ ра́ди прⷪ҇ро́къ со а҆́гг҃лы глаго́лаше зовы́й: сла́ва прише́ствїю твое́мꙋ хрⷭ҇тѐ: сла́ва црⷭ҇твїю твое́мꙋ: сла́ва смотре́нїю твое́мꙋ: є҆ди́не чл҃колю́бче.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Оу҆слы́шахъ гдⷭ҇и гла́съ тво́й є҆го́же ре́клъ є҆сѝ, гла́съ вопїю́щагѡ въ пꙋсты́ни, ꙗ҆́кѡ возгремѣ́лъ є҆сѝ над̾ вода́ми мно́гими, твое́мꙋ свидѣ́тельствоваѧ сн҃ꋋ, ве́сь бы́въ соше́дшагѡ дх҃а, возопѝ: ты̀ є҆сѝ хрⷭ҇то́съ бж҃їа мꙋ́дрость и҆ си́ла.
items.english_cohort_translation: I heard, O Lord, Thy voice which Thou didst speak, the voice of one crying in the wilderness,[^1248] when Thou didst thunder over many waters, bearing witness unto Thy Son; being wholly filled with the Spirit Who had descended, he cried aloud: Thou art Christ, the Wisdom and Power of God![^1249]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ѡ҆чища́емо со́лнце кто̀ ви́дѣ? проповѣ́дникъ вопїе́тъ, пресвѣ́тлое є҆стество́мъ: да тебѐ вода́ми сїѧ́нїе сла́вы, ѻ҆ц҃а̀ ѻ҆́бразъ присносꙋ́щнагѡ ѡ҆мы́ю: и҆ сѣ́но сы́й, ѻ҆гню̀ прикоснꙋ́сѧ твоегѡ̀ бж҃ества̀. ты̀ бо є҆сѝ хрⷭ҇то́съ, бж҃їа мꙋ́дрость и҆ си́ла.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion of the Feast:* "Who hath ever seen the sun cleansed, which is most radiant by nature?" cries the Herald: "That I may wash with waters Thee, the Radiance of the Father's glory, the Image of the Ever-Existing One?[^1250] And being grass, shall I touch the fire of Thy Godhead? For Thou art Christ, the Wisdom and Power of God!"

items.office: At Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 3, Podoben: "Today the Virgin" (Дѣ́ва дне́сь)
items.slavonic_diplomatic: И҆ви́въ бж҃твенное, є҆́же и҆мѣ̀ бл҃гоговѣ́нїе мѡѷсе́й прилꙋчи́сѧ тебѣ̀: ꙗ҆́кѡ бо и҆з̾ кꙋпины̀ тѧ̀ возгласи́вша ра́зꙋмѣ, а҆́бїе ѿвратѝ лицѐ, а҆́зъ же ка́кѡ тѧ̀ оу҆ви́ждꙋ ꙗ҆́снѡ? и҆лѝ ка́кѡ рꙋ́кꙋ положꙋ̀ на тѧ̀? ты́ бо є҆сѝ хрⷭ҇то́съ, бж҃їа мꙋ́дрость и҆ си́ла.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion of the Feast:* Moses, having shown the divine reverence which he possessed, drew near unto Thee; for when he perceived Thee speaking out of the bush, he immediately turned away his face;[^1251] but how shall I behold Thee clearly, or how shall I lay my hand upon Thee? For Thou art Christ, the Wisdom and Power of God!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Дꙋше́вное соверша́ѧ мꙋ́дрѣ, и҆ сло́вомъ почте́ный, бѣ́здушныхъ стыждꙋ́сѧ. а҆́ще бо крещꙋ́ тѧ, клеве́тна мѝ є҆́сть ѻ҆гне́мъ дымѧ́щаѧсѧ гора̀, побѣ́гшее же мо́ре на дво́е, и҆ і҆орда́нъ се́й возврати́выйсѧ: ты́ бо є҆сѝ хрⷭ҇то́съ бж҃їа мꙋ́дрость и҆ си́ла.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion of the Feast:* Performing the spiritual wisely and honored with speech, I am ashamed before inanimate things; for if I baptize Thee, a mountain smoking with fire shall accuse me, and the sea that fled in twain, and this Jordan that turned back:[^1252] for Thou art Christ, the Wisdom and Power of God!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: И҆́нъ. і҆рмо́съ: Бж҃твенное твоѐ разꙋмѣ́въ и҆стоща́нїе, прозорли́вѡ а҆ввакꙋ́мъ, хрⷭ҇тѐ со тре́петомъ вопїѧ́ше тебѣ̀: во спасе́нїе люде́й твои́хъ, спастѝ пома́занныѧ твоѧ̑ прише́лъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Perceiving Thine emptyings befitting God, Habakkuk cried out unto Thee with trembling, O Christ, looking ahead: Thou hast come for the salvation of Thy people, to save Thine anointed ones![^1253]

items.office: At Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 3, Podoben: "Today the Virgin" (Дѣ́ва дне́сь)
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Богородиченъ: Без̾ смѣше́нїа оу҆́бѡ зачала̀ є҆сѝ нетлѣ́ннѡ во оу҆тро́бѣ, и҆ пре́жде болѣ́зни родила̀ є҆сѝ, и҆ по ржⷭ҇твѣ̀ дв҃а, бг҃а пло́тїю ро́ждши, сохрани́ласѧ є҆сѝ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* Without confusion didst thou conceive incorruptibly in thy womb, and didst give birth before travail, and after childbirth didst remain a virgin, having borne God in the flesh.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: И҆́нъ. і҆рмо́съ: Го́рꙋ тѧ̀ бл҃года́тїю бж҃їею приѡсѣне́ннꙋю, прозорли́выма а҆ввакꙋ́мъ оу҆смотри́въ ѻ҆чи́ма, и҆з̾ тебѐ и҆зы́ти і҆и҃левꙋ провозглаша́ше ст҃о́мꙋ, во спасе́нїе на́ше и҆ ѡ҆бновле́нїе.
items.english_cohort_translation: Habakkuk, having perceived with farsighted eyes the mountain overshadowed by God's grace, proclaimed that the Holy One of Israel should come forth from thee, for our salvation and renewal.[^1256]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Зако́нъ бл҃года́ти показа́лъ є҆сѝ бы́ти сѣ́нь, сꙋ́щымъ въ зако́нѣ бж҃їи є҆вре́емъ чтꙋ́щымъ мꙋ́дре. и҆ є҆ѵлїе и҆́стиннагѡ бг҃оꙗвле́нїа та́инство, хрⷭ҇тꙋ̀ взыва́ѧ: сла́ва си́лѣ твое́й гдⷭ҇и.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Thou didst show the Law to be a shadow of grace unto the Hebrews who honor God's law, O wise one, and the mystery of the true Theophany to be the Gospel, crying out unto Christ: Glory to Thy power, O Lord![^1257]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ѡ҆блиста́въ ꙗ҆́кѡ ѕвѣзда̀ ѿ восто́ка многосвѣ́тлаа, цр҃ковь просвѣща́еши проповѣ́даѧ хрⷭ҇та̀, мꙋ́дрыми показа́ньми всебл҃гоче́стнѡ пра́вды сл҃нца, томꙋ̀ взыва́ѧ: сла́ва си́лѣ твое́й гдⷭ҇и.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Having flashed forth as a star of many lights from the East, thou dost enlighten the Church, proclaiming Christ the Sun of Righteousness with wise demonstrations in all piety, crying out unto Him: Glory to Thy power, O Lord!

items.office: At Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 3, Podoben: "Today the Virgin" (Дѣ́ва дне́сь)
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Зло́бы всѧ́кїѧ ѿто́ргнꙋвсѧ, и҆ любвѐ вре́менныѧ ѻ҆́ч҃е со тща́нїемъ. и҆ просвѣти́лъ є҆сѝ свѣ́томъ, ѻ҆́течества твоегѡ̀ концы̀ мꙋ́дре. и҆ си̑мъ бога́тство ѡ҆дожди́лъ є҆сѝ, ѻ҆би́льнѣйшимъ бога́тства коли́чествомъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Having broken away from all malice and with diligence from temporal love, O father, thou didst enlighten with light the ends of thy fatherland, O wise one; and thou didst rain down riches upon them with an abundant quantity of wealth.[^1258]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Богородиченъ: Сло́во ꙗ҆́кѡ бг҃ъ сы́й неви́димый, прїи́мъ ѿ жены̀ человѣ́чо є҆стество̀ ви́димо, соверша́етъ и҆ ѡ҆чища́етъ въ рѣцѣ̀, и҆́же грѣха̀ чꙋ́ждїй, па́дшагѡ ѡ҆чища́ѧ прегрѣше́нїа.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* The Word, being invisible God, having received visible human nature from a woman, accomplishes and cleanses in the river; He Who is a stranger to sin cleanses the transgressions of the fallen.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Canon of the Feast. Ode 5. Heirmos:*
items.office: At Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 3, Podoben: "Today the Virgin" (Дѣ́ва дне́сь)
items.slavonic_diplomatic: І҆и҃съ живота̀ нача́лникъ, разрѣши́ти ѡ҆сꙋжде́нїе грѧде́тъ, а҆да́ма первозда́ннагѡ, ѡ҆чище́нїй же ꙗ҆́кѡ бг҃ъ не тре́бꙋѧ, па́дшаго ѡ҆чища́етъ во і҆орда́нѣ: въ не́мже враждꙋ̀ оу҆би́въ, премꙋ́щъ всѧ́къ оу҆́мъ ми́ръ да́рꙋетъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Jesus, the Prince of Life, comes to loose the condemnation of Adam the first-formed; and needing no cleansing, as He is God, He cleanses the fallen one in the Jordan: wherein having slain the enmity, He grants peace which surpasses all understanding.[^1259]

items.office: At Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 3, Podoben: "Today the Virgin" (Дѣ́ва дне́сь)
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Сше́дшымсѧ без̾ числа̀ лю́демъ ѿ і҆ѡа́нна крⷭ҇ти́тисѧ, са́мъ посредѣ̀ и҆́хъ ста̀, провозгласи́ же предстоя́щымъ: кто̀ показа̀ непокори́ві́и гнѣ́ва ва́мъ оу҆клони́тисѧ хотѧ́щагѡ бы́ти? плоды̀ досто́йны хрⷭ҇тꙋ̀ сотвори́те, предстоѧ́й бо ннѣ̀ ми́ръ да́рꙋетъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion of the Feast:* When countless multitudes assembled to be baptized by John, he himself stood in their midst and proclaimed to those standing by: "Who hath warned you, ye disobedient, to flee from the wrath to come?[^1260] Bring forth fruits worthy of Christ; for He that stands here now grants peace!"

items.office: At Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 3, Podoben: "Today the Virgin" (Дѣ́ва дне́сь)
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Дѣ́латель и҆ зижди́тель посредѣ̀ стоѧ́й, ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆ди́нъ всѣ́хъ сердца̀ и҆спы́тꙋетъ. ѡ҆чисти́телнꙋю же лопа́тꙋ рꙋко́ю прїе́мъ, всемї́рное гꙋмно̀ всемꙋ́дрѣ разлꙋча́етъ, непло́дїе палѧ̀, бл҃гопло́днымъ вѣ́чный живо́тъ да́рꙋетъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion of the Feast:* The Husbandman and Creator, standing in their midst, tests the hearts of all as He alone can do; and taking the purifying winnowing-fan in His hand, He all-wisely separates the threshing floor of the whole world: burning the unfruitful, He grants eternal life unto the fruitful.[^1261]

items.office: At Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 3, Podoben: "Today the Virgin" (Дѣ́ва дне́сь)
items.slavonic_diplomatic: И҆́нъ. і҆рмо́съ: Ѡ҆дѣѧ́йсѧ свѣ́томъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ри́зою, къ тебѣ̀ оу҆́тренюю, и҆ тебѣ̀ и҆ тебѣ̀ зовꙋ̀: дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ просвѣтѝ ѡ҆мраче́ннꙋю хрⷭ҇тѐ, ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆ди́нъ бл҃гоꙋтро́бенъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Thou Who clothest Thyself with light as with a garment, I awake early unto Thee, and unto Thee and unto Thee I cry: Enlighten my darkened soul, O Christ, as Thou alone art compassionate.[^1262]

items.office: At Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 3, Podoben: "Today the Virgin" (Дѣ́ва дне́сь)
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ты̀ ꙗ҆́кѡ ѻ҆́гнь попали́лъ є҆сѝ є҆ресе́й те́рнонѡ́снаѧ плете́нїа слове́съ, вѣ́рныхъ же оу҆мы̀ просвѣти́лъ є҆сѝ бл҃же́нне, тайново́дче григо́рїе.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* As fire, thou didst burn up the thorn-bearing woven webs of heretical words, but the minds of the faithful thou didst enlighten, O blessed one, mystagogue Gregory.

items.office: At Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 3, Podoben: "Today the Virgin" (Дѣ́ва дне́сь)
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Є҆ѵномї́ево ты̀ и҆з̾ѡбличи́лъ є҆сѝ беззако́нїе, и҆ сегѡ̀ словеса̀ неꙋдобоизбѣ́жнаѧ: сѣте́й же прꙋ̑гла бѣ́лила, ꙗ҆́кѡ паꙋчи̑ннаѧ тка̑нїа разорѝлъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Thou didst expose the iniquity of Eunomius, and his inescapable words; and the snares of his nets thou didst tear apart like spider webs.[^1263]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Богородиченъ: Ты̀ пра́вдꙋ же и҆ и҆збавле́нїе на́мъ ро́ждши хрⷭ҇та̀, без̾сѣ́меннѡ: свобо́дно содѣ́лала є҆сѝ ѿ кла́твы бцⷣе, є҆стество̀ пра́ѻтца.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* Having seedlessly given birth unto Christ, our Righteousness and Redemption, O Mother of God, thou didst make free from the curse the nature of our forefather.[^1265]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: И҆́нъ. і҆рмо́съ: Просвѣти́вый сїѧ́нїемъ прише́ствїа твоегѡ̀ хрⷭ҇тѐ, и҆ ѡ҆свѣти́вый крⷭ҇то́мъ твои́мъ мі́ра концы̀, сердца̀ просвѣтѝ, свѣ́томъ твоегѡ̀ бг҃оразꙋ́мїа, правосла́внѡ пою́щихъ тѧ̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: Thou Who hast enlightened the ends of the world with the radiance of Thy coming, O Christ, and illuminated them with Thy Cross, enlighten the hearts of those who orthodoxly hymn Thee with the light of the knowledge of God.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Призрѣ̀ на зе́млю влⷭ҇ка тва́ри, и҆ сїѧ̀ поколеба́шасѧ бгомꙋ́дре, винова̑нїа, и҆ лю́тѣ сотрѧсо́шасѧ: тебе́ же дꙋше́внагѡ мꙋ́жества ѻ҆́ч҃е ѿ моли́твы не оу҆клонѝ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* The Master of creation looked upon the earth, and the causes of earthquakes shook and trembled grievously, O God-wise one; yet the earthquake turned thee not away from prayer nor shook the courage of thy soul, O father.[^1266]

items.office: At Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 3, Podoben: "Today the Virgin" (Дѣ́ва дне́сь)
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Не терпѣ́лъ є҆сѝ хꙋ́лѧщихъ слы́шати сла́вне на высотꙋ̀, и҆ глаго́лати непра́вдꙋ безꙋ́мныѧ: но тѣ́хъ ѡ҆брати́лъ є҆сѝ па́стырскимъ твои́мъ жезло́мъ, и҆ недꙋ́жное и҆сцѣли́лъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Thou couldst not bear to hear the blasphemers speaking against the heights, O glorious one, nor the senseless speaking unrighteousness; but thou didst turn them back with thy pastoral staff, and didst heal the sick.

items.office: At Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 3, Podoben: "Today the Virgin" (Дѣ́ва дне́сь)
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Є҆ди́но є҆стество̀ во хрⷭ҇тѣ̀, и҆мѣ́ющымъ проповѣ́дати бг҃оглаго́ливе, ника́коже попꙋсти́лъ є҆сѝ сло́жное: но тѣ́хъ оу҆лови́лъ є҆сѝ оу҆че́нїй твои́хъ мре́жею, и҆ к свѣ́тꙋ возве́лъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Unto those who preached one composite nature in Christ, O speaker of divine things, thou didst by no means yield; but thou didst catch them in the net of thy teachings, and didst lead them unto the light.[^1267]

items.office: At Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 3, Podoben: "Today the Virgin" (Дѣ́ва дне́сь)
items.english_cohort_translation: The voice of the Word, the lamp of the Light, the dayspring of the Sun, the Forerunner in the wilderness cries aloud unto all people: Repent and be purified beforehand! For lo, Christ stands present, delivering the world from corruption.[^1269]

items.office: At Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 3, Podoben: "Today the Virgin" (Дѣ́ва дне́сь)
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Рожде́йсѧ нетлѣ́ннѡ ѿ бг҃а и҆ ѻ҆ц҃а̀: ѿ дв҃ы кромѣ̀ скве́рны воплоща́етсѧ хрⷭ҇то́съ: є҆мꙋ́же реме́нь, є҆́же ѿ на́съ сло́ва сочта́нїа, разрѣши́ти неꙋдо́бь оу҆чи́тъ предте́ча, земнорѡ́дныѧ ѿ ле́сти и҆збавлѧ́ѧ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion of the Feast:* Born incorruptibly from God and the Father, Christ is incarnate without defilement from the Virgin; the strap of the union of the Word with us, the Forerunner teaches, is hard to loose, delivering the earthborn from deception.[^1270]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Смиренное мꙋдрова́нїе стѧжа́въ, всѣ̑мъ же кро́токъ боре́цъ показа́лсѧ є҆сѝ григо́рїе, проти́вꙋ тща́щымсѧ оу҆ма́лити сла́вꙋ хрⷭ҇то́вꙋ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Having acquired humble mindedness, yet appearing unto all as a meek champion, O Gregory, against those who strove to diminish Christ's glory.

items.office: At Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 3, Podoben: "Today the Virgin" (Дѣ́ва дне́сь)
items.slavonic_diplomatic: А҆́рїево ѡ҆чꙋжде́нїе трⷪ҇цы, сло́вомъ бога́тнымъ дерзо́стное раздѣле́нїе григо́рїе, и҆ всеконе́чнѡ низложи́лъ є҆сѝ мꙋдрова́нїа.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* The alienation of the Trinity by Arius, and the audacious division by his word, O Gregory, thou didst utterly cast down their reasonings.[^1273]

items.office: At Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 3, Podoben: "Today the Virgin" (Дѣ́ва дне́сь)
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Несѣ́ченнѡ соединенїе трⷪ҇ческое, смѣше́нїе мꙋ́дрствꙋѧ, тобо́ю саве́ллїй ѡ҆бличи́сѧ бг҃оборе́цъ, григо́рїе всеблаже́нне.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Deeming the indivisible union of the Trinity to be a confusion, the god-fighting Sabellius was exposed through thee, O all-blessed Gregory.[^1274]

items.office: At Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 3, Podoben: "Today the Virgin" (Дѣ́ва дне́сь)
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Богородиченъ: Дв҃а родѝ, и҆ ро́ждши пребы́сть чиста̀. на рꙋка́хъ носѧ́щаго всѧ́чєскаѧ, ꙗ҆́кѡ вои́стиннꙋ дв҃о мт҃и носи́вши.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* A Virgin gave birth, and having given birth remained pure: carrying in her arms Him Who upholds all things, as truly having carried Him, O Virgin Mother.

items.office: At Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 3, Podoben: "Today the Virgin" (Дѣ́ва дне́сь)
items.slavonic_diplomatic: И҆́нъ. і҆рмо́съ: Ѡ҆бы́де на́съ послѣ́днаѧ бе́здна, нѣ́сть и҆збавлѧ́ѧй, вмѣни́хомсѧ ꙗ҆́кѡ ѻ҆́вцы заколе́нїа, спасѝ лю́ди твоѧ̑ бж҃е на́шъ. ты́ бо крѣ́пость немощствꙋ́ющихъ и҆ и҆справле́нїе.
items.english_cohort_translation: The uttermost deep hath compassed us, and there is none to deliver; we are accounted as sheep for the slaughter; save Thy people, O our God: for Thou art the strength of the weak and their restoration.[^1275]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: И҆зба́вишасѧ ꙗ҆́кѡ ѿ сѣ́ти прпⷣбне сме́ртныѧ бѣ́дствꙋющїи лю́дїе, и҆ страсте́й мно́жество дале́че ма́твами твои́ми ѿгна́сѧ: и҆́бо са́ми пе́рсїи тѧ̀ и҆мѣ́ша застꙋ́пника.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* The people in distress were delivered as from a deadly snare, O venerable one, and a multitude of passions was driven far away by thy prayers; for the Persians themselves had thee as a protector.[^1276]

items.office: At Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 3, Podoben: "Today the Virgin" (Дѣ́ва дне́сь)
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Потреби́лъ є҆сѝ моли́твою всемꙋ́дре стремле́нїе недꙋ́га, къ дв҃ѣ и҆ мт҃ри и҆зба́вителѧ ско́рѡ прите́къ: не бо́ стерпѣ́лъ є҆сѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ па́стырь сы́й, бѣ́дствꙋющей па́ствѣ пренебрега́тисѧ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Thou didst destroy the onslaught of disease by prayer, O all-wise one, having swiftly fled unto the Virgin and Mother of the Redeemer; for being a shepherd, thou couldst not bear to see thy suffering flock neglected.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Богородиченъ: Оу҆жасо́шасѧ а҆́ггл҃стїи чи́ни, зрѧ́ще неви́димаго и҆з̾ дв҃ы ро́ждшасѧ пло́тїю, и҆ невеще́ственнѡ сла́вимаго, въ рѣцѣ̀ крести́тисѧ приходѧ́ща.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* The angelic ranks were struck with dread, beholding the Invisible One born in the flesh from the Virgin, and celebrated immaterially, coming to be baptized in the river.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Конда́къ, гла́съ а҃. Подо́бенъ: Ли́къ а҆́ггл҃скїй: Ѻ҆гне́мъ дꙋше́внымъ во́дрствова ста́ю, бо́дръ па́стырь ꙗ҆ви́лсѧ є҆сѝ мі́рꙋ: и҆ жезло́мъ мꙋ́дрости твоеѧ̀, и҆ те́плымъ предста́телствомъ твои́мъ, всѧ̑ ѿгна́лъ є҆сѝ ѕлосла́вныѧ ꙗ҆́кѡ во́лки, невре́дно соблю́дъ ста́до григо́рїе всемꙋ́дре.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Kontakion, Tone 1, Podoben: "The Angelic Choir" (Ли́къ а҆́гг҃льскїй):* Watching over the flock with spiritual fire, thou wast shown forth unto the world as a vigilant shepherd; and by the staff of thy wisdom and thy warm intercession, thou didst drive away all the evil-believing as wolves, keeping the flock unharmed, O all-wise Gregory.[^1277]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ю҆́ношы бл҃гочести̑вымъ пе́щи ѻ҆́гненнѣй приѡбщи́вшымсѧ, шꙋмѧ́щь дх҃ъ ро́сный невреди́мы сохранѝ, и҆ бж҃їа а҆́гг҃ла снизхожде́нїе: тѣ́мже въ пла́мени ѡ҆роша́еми бл҃годарственнѡ воспѣва́хꙋ: препѣ́тый ѻ҆ц҃ъ гдⷭ҇ь и҆ бг҃ъ бл҃гослове́нъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_cohort_translation: When the pious youths were cast into the fiery furnace, the dewy breeze of the Spirit and the descent of the angel of God preserved them unharmed; therefore, bedewed in the flame, they sang thankfully: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God of our fathers, praised above all![^1279]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ꙗ҆́коже на нб҃сѝ съ тре́петомъ и҆ чꙋ́домъ, предстоѧ́хꙋ во і҆орда́нѣ си́лы а҆́ггл҃скїа, смотрѧ́юще толи́ка бж҃їа схожде́нїа. ꙗ҆́кѡ держа́й превы́шнихъ во́дъ соста́въ, въ вода́хъ плотоно́сецъ стоѧ́ше, бг҃ъ ѻ҆ц҃ъ на́шихъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion of the Feast:* As in heaven, with trembling and wonder the angelic powers stood present at the Jordan, looking upon such a condescension of God: how He Who holds the structure of the waters above stood clothed in flesh in the waters, the God of our fathers![^1280]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ѡ҆́блакъ дре́вле и҆ мо́ре, бж҃е́ственагѡ проѡбража́хꙋ креще́нїѧ чꙋ́до, въ ни́хже дре́вні́и крести́шасѧ, и҆сходя́ще зако́ннїи лю́дїе: мо́ре же бѣ̀ ѻ҆́бразъ воды̀, и҆ ѡ҆́блакъ дх҃а. и҆́миже соверша́еми, бл҃гве́нъ є҆сѝ, зове́мъ: гдⷭ҇и бж҃е вовѣ́ки.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Всѝ вѣ́рнїи, въ не́мже соверше́нїе прїѧ́хомъ, бг҃осло́вѧще немо́лчнѡ со а҆́гг҃лы просла́вимъ, ѻ҆ц҃а̀, и҆ сн҃а, и҆ дх҃а ст҃а́го. се́ бо трⷪ҇ца ѵ҆поста́сми є҆диносꙋ́щными, є҆ди́нъ же бг҃ъ, є҆мꙋ́же пое́мъ: бл҃гве́нъ є҆сѝ гдⷭ҇и бж҃е во вѣ́ки.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion of the Feast:* All ye faithful, wherein we have received perfection, theologizing unceasingly with the angels, let us glorify the Father, and the Son, and the Holy Spirit; for lo, the Trinity is in consubstantial hypostases, yet one God, unto Whom we sing: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God, unto ages![^1282]

items.office: At Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 3, Podoben: "Today the Virgin" (Дѣ́ва дне́сь)
items.slavonic_diplomatic: И҆́нъ. і҆рмо́съ: Тебѐ оу҆́мнꙋю бцⷣе пе́щь, разсмо́тримъ вѣ́рнїи. ꙗ҆́коже бо ѻ҆́троки спасѐ трѝ превозноси́мый, мі́ръ ѡ҆бновѝ, во чре́вѣ твое́мъ всецѣ́лъ, хва́лимый
items.english_cohort_translation: Let us, the faithful, contemplate thee as a spiritual furnace, O Mother of God; for as He that is praised above all saved the three youths, so the praised and supremely glorified God of the fathers renewed the whole world within thy womb.[^1286]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Нело́жное вѣ́рнымъ соверши́сѧ ѡ҆бѣтова́нїе проꙗвле́ннѡ: бж҃твенный бо дометїа́нъ бл҃года́ти сподо́бисѧ рѣши́ти недꙋ́ги, и҆ ѿгона́ти де́мѡны, хва́лнаго провозвѣща́ѧ бг҃а препросла́вленнаго.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* The unfailing promise was manifestly accomplished for the faithful; for divine Dometian was vouchsafed grace to loose infirmities and drive out demons, proclaiming the praised and supremely glorified God.[^1287]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Злочести̑выѧ низложѝ є҆ре́си, бж҃твенный дометїа́нъ, севи́рова оу҆че́нїа: и҆ непрело́жнꙋю вѣ́рꙋ и҆ правосла́внꙋю бг҃олѣ́пнѡ назна́мена. хва́лнаго возвѣща́ѧ бг҃а, и҆ препросла́вленнаго.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Divine Dometian cast down impious heresies, the teachings of Severus; and he marked out the immutable and orthodox faith in a manner befitting God, proclaiming the praised and supremely glorified God.[^1288]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Та́йнꙋ пресла́внꙋю вавѷлѡ́нскаѧ показа̀ пе́щь и҆сточи́вшаѧ ро́сꙋ, ꙗ҆́кѡ стрꙋѧ́ми и҆ма́ше невеще́ственный ѻ҆́гнь воспрїѧ́ти і҆орда́нъ, и҆ ѡ҆б̾ѧ́ти пло́тїю креща́ема зижди́телѧ: є҆го́же бл҃гословѧ́тъ лю́дїе, и҆ превозно́сѧтъ во всѧ̑ вѣ́ки.
items.english_cohort_translation: A most glorious mystery did the furnace of Babylon reveal, pouring forth dew, showing that the Jordan was about to receive the immaterial Fire in its streams, and to embrace the Creator baptized in the flesh: Whom people bless and exalt supremely unto all ages![^1290]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Глаго́лы ꙗ҆́коже оу҆слы́ша крести́тель влⷣчни, съ тре́петомъ дла́нь простира́етъ: ѻ҆ба́че же рꙋко́ю ко́снꙋсѧ верхꙋ̀ зижди́телѧ своего̀ кре́пше, вопїѧ́ше: ѡ҆ст҃и́ мѧ, ты́ бо є҆сѝ бг҃ъ мо́й: є҆го́же бл҃гословѧ́тъ лю́дїе, и҆ превозно́сѧтъ во всѧ̑ вѣ́ки.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion of the Feast:* When the Baptist heard the Master's words, he stretched forth his hand with trembling; yet touching the crown of his Creator's head with his hand more boldly, he cried aloud: "Sanctify me, for Thou art my God: Whom people bless and exalt supremely unto all ages!"

items.office: At Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 3, Podoben: "Today the Virgin" (Дѣ́ва дне́сь)
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Трⷪ҇цы ꙗ҆вле́нїе во і҆орда́нѣ бы́сть, са́мое бо пребж҃е́ственное є҆стество̀, ѻ҆ц҃ъ возгласѝ: се́й крⷭ҇ща́емый сн҃ъ возлю́бленный мо́й. дх҃ъ же прїи́де къ подо́бномꙋ, є҆го́же бл҃гословѧ́тъ лю́дїе, и҆ превозно́сѧтъ во всѧ̑ вѣ́ки.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion of the Feast:* The manifestation of the Trinity took place at the Jordan; for the most divine Nature Itself, even the Father, cried aloud: "This is My beloved Son Who is baptized!" And the Spirit came unto His equal: Whom people bless and exalt supremely unto all ages![^1292]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: И҆́нъ. і҆рмо́съ: Тебѣ̀ вседѣ́телю, въ пещѝ ѻ҆́троцы, всемї́рный ли́къ спле́тше поѧ́хꙋ: дѣла̀ всѧ́каѧ гдⷭ҇а по́йте, и҆ превозноси́те во всѧ̑ вѣ́ки.
